    class_name: str | ArgNotSet = NOTSET,
    packages: list[str] | ArgNotSet = NOTSET,
    app_arguments: list[str] | ArgNotSet = NOTSET,
    app_id_suffix: Callable[[], str] | ArgNotSet = NOTSET,
    app_waiter: Literal["no_wait", "wait", "log"] | ArgNotSet = NOTSET,
    image_pull_policy: Literal["Always", "Never", "IfNotPresent"] | ArgNotSet = NOTSET,
    ui_reverse_proxy: bool | ArgNotSet = NOTSET,
    driver_resources: PodResources | ArgNotSet = NOTSET,
    executor_resources: PodResources | ArgNotSet = NOTSET,
    executor_instances: ExecutorInstances | ArgNotSet = NOTSET,
    should_print: bool | ArgNotSet = NOTSET,
    secret_values: dict[str, str] | ArgNotSet = NOTSET,
    driver_ephemeral_configmaps_volumes: list[ConfigMap] | ArgNotSet = NOTSET,
    driver_env_vars_from_secrets: list[str] | ArgNotSet = NOTSET,
    volumes: list[k8s.V1Volume] | ArgNotSet = NOTSET,
    driver_volume_mounts: list[k8s.V1VolumeMount] | ArgNotSet = NOTSET,
    executor_volume_mounts: list[k8s.V1VolumeMount] | ArgNotSet = NOTSET,
    driver_node_selector: dict[str, str] | ArgNotSet = NOTSET,
    executor_node_selector: dict[str, str] | ArgNotSet = NOTSET,
    driver_annotations: dict[str, str] | ArgNotSet = NOTSET,
    executor_annotations: dict[str, str] | ArgNotSet = NOTSET,
    driver_labels: dict[str, str] | ArgNotSet = NOTSET,
    executor_labels: dict[str, str] | ArgNotSet = NOTSET,
    driver_tolerations: list[k8s.V1Toleration] | ArgNotSet = NOTSET,
    executor_pod_template_path: str | ArgNotSet = NOTSET,
    executor_pod_template: str | ArgNotSet = NOTSET,
    startup_timeout: int | ArgNotSet = NOTSET,
    wait_timeout: float | None = None,
    driver_init_containers: list[k8s.V1Container] | ArgNotSet = NOTSET,
    driver_host_aliases: list[k8s.V1HostAlias] | ArgNotSet = NOTSET,
    driver_pod_template: str | Path | Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
    driver_container_name: str | None = None,
    dry_run: bool = False,
) -> str | ApplicationPlan:
    """Submit a Spark app to Kubernetes

    Args:
        image: Docker image to use for the Spark driver and executors
        app_path: Path to the application JAR / Python / R file
        namespace: Kubernetes namespace to use, defaults to "default"
        service_account: Kubernetes service account to use for the Spark driver,
            defaults to "spark"
        app_name: Name of the Spark application, defaults to a generated name as
            `spark-app{app_id_suffix()}`
        spark_conf: Dictionary of spark configuration to pass to the application
        class_name: Name of the class to execute
        packages: List of maven coordinates of jars to include in the classpath
        app_arguments: List of arguments to pass to the application
        app_id_suffix: Function to generate a suffix for the application ID, defaults to
            `default_app_id_suffix`
        app_waiter: How to wait for the app to finish. One of "no_wait", "wait", or "log"
        image_pull_policy: Image pull policy for the driver and executors, defaults to "IfNotPresent"
        ui_reverse_proxy: Whether to use a reverse proxy for the Spark UI, defaults to False
        driver_resources: Resources to request for the Spark driver. Defaults to 1 CPU core, 1Gi of
            memory and512Mi of memory overhead
        executor_resources: Resources to request for the Spark executors. Defaults to 1 CPU core, 1Gi
            of memory and 512Mi of memory overhead
        executor_instances: Number of executors to request. If max and min are not provided, dynamic
            allocation will be disabled and the number of executors will be fixed to initial or 2 if
            initial is not provided. If max or min or both are provided, dynamic allocation will be
            enabled and the number of executors will be between min and max (inclusive), and initial
            will be the initial number of executors with a default of 0.
        should_print: Whether to print logs instead of logging them, defaults to False
        secret_values: Dictionary of secret values to pass to the application as environment variables
        driver_ephemeral_configmaps_volumes: List of ephemeral configmaps to create for the application
            driver
        driver_env_vars_from_secrets: List of secret names to load environment variables from for
            the driver
        volumes: List of volumes to mount to the driver and/or executors
        driver_volume_mounts: List of volume mounts to mount to the driver
        executor_volume_mounts: List of volume mounts to mount to the executors
        driver_node_selector: Node selector for the driver
        executor_node_selector: Node selector for the executors
        driver_tolerations: List of tolerations for the driver
        executor_pod_template_path: Path to the executor pod template file
        executor_pod_template: Executor pod template content as string or local file path. If provided,
            a ConfigMap will be created and mounted automatically
        startup_timeout: Timeout in seconds to wait for the application to start
        driver_init_containers: List of init containers to run before the driver starts
        driver_host_aliases: List of host aliases for the driver
        driver_pod_template: Driver Pod YAML text, a local file path, or a mapping.
            Generated identity and launch settings override the template; other fields are preserved.
        driver_container_name: Container to use as the driver in the template. Defaults to the
            container named "driver", or the sole container. Ambiguous templates are rejected.
        dry_run: Build an offline plan without opening a Kubernetes connection or creating resources.

    Returns:
        Name of the Spark application pod. The same identity is available as last_submitted_run.

    The optional wait_timeout bounds observation after resource creation, in seconds.
    It does not stop or delete the application. None preserves unlimited waiting.
    """
    if not dry_run:
        self.last_submitted_run = None
        self.last_submitted_app_id = None
        self.last_submission_phase = "preparing"
    WaitDeadline(wait_timeout)
    if driver_container_name is not None and driver_pod_template is None:
        raise ValueError("driver_container_name requires driver_pod_template")
    template = load_driver_pod_template(driver_pod_template) if driver_pod_template is not None else None
    if image is NOTSET:
        if Configuration.SPARK_ON_K8S_DOCKER_IMAGE is None:
            raise ValueError(
                "Docker image is not set. "
                "Please set the image argument or the environment variable SPARK_ON_K8S_DOCKER_IMAGE"
            )
        image = Configuration.SPARK_ON_K8S_DOCKER_IMAGE
    if app_path is NOTSET:
        if Configuration.SPARK_ON_K8S_APP_PATH is None:
            raise ValueError(
                "Application path is not set. "
                "Please set the app_path argument or the environment variable SPARK_ON_K8S_APP_PATH"
            )
        app_path = Configuration.SPARK_ON_K8S_APP_PATH
    if namespace is NOTSET:
        namespace = Configuration.SPARK_ON_K8S_NAMESPACE
    if service_account is NOTSET:
        service_account = Configuration.SPARK_ON_K8S_SERVICE_ACCOUNT
    if app_name is NOTSET:
        app_name = Configuration.SPARK_ON_K8S_APP_NAME
    if spark_conf is NOTSET:
        spark_conf = Configuration.SPARK_ON_K8S_SPARK_CONF
    if class_name is NOTSET:
        class_name = Configuration.SPARK_ON_K8S_CLASS_NAME
    if packages is NOTSET:
        packages = (
            Configuration.SPARK_ON_K8S_PACKAGES.split(",") if Configuration.SPARK_ON_K8S_PACKAGES else []
        )
    if app_arguments is NOTSET:
        app_arguments = Configuration.SPARK_ON_K8S_APP_ARGUMENTS
    if app_id_suffix is NOTSET:
        app_id_suffix = default_app_id_suffix
    if app_waiter is NOTSET:
        app_waiter = Configuration.SPARK_ON_K8S_APP_WAITER
    if image_pull_policy is NOTSET:
        image_pull_policy = Configuration.SPARK_ON_K8S_IMAGE_PULL_POLICY
    if ui_reverse_proxy is NOTSET:
        ui_reverse_proxy = Configuration.SPARK_ON_K8S_UI_REVERSE_PROXY
    if driver_resources is NOTSET:
        driver_resources = PodResources(
            cpu=Configuration.SPARK_ON_K8S_DRIVER_CPU,
            memory=Configuration.SPARK_ON_K8S_DRIVER_MEMORY,
            memory_overhead=Configuration.SPARK_ON_K8S_DRIVER_MEMORY_OVERHEAD,
        )
    if executor_resources is NOTSET:
        executor_resources = PodResources(
            cpu=Configuration.SPARK_ON_K8S_EXECUTOR_CPU,
            memory=Configuration.SPARK_ON_K8S_EXECUTOR_MEMORY,
            memory_overhead=Configuration.SPARK_ON_K8S_EXECUTOR_MEMORY_OVERHEAD,
        )
    if executor_instances is NOTSET:
        executor_instances = ExecutorInstances(
            min=Configuration.SPARK_ON_K8S_EXECUTOR_MIN_INSTANCES,
            max=Configuration.SPARK_ON_K8S_EXECUTOR_MAX_INSTANCES,
            initial=Configuration.SPARK_ON_K8S_EXECUTOR_INITIAL_INSTANCES,
            executor_allocation_ratio=Configuration.SPARK_ON_K8S_EXECUTOR_ALLOCATION_RATIO,
            scheduler_backlog_timeout=Configuration.SPARK_ON_K8S_SCHEDULER_BACKLOG_TIMEOUT,
            sustained_scheduler_backlog_timeout=Configuration.SPARK_ON_K8S_SUSTAINED_SCHEDULER_BACKLOG_TIMEOUT,
        )
        if (
            executor_instances.min is None
            and executor_instances.max is None
            and executor_instances.initial is None
        ):
            executor_instances.initial = 2
    if should_print is NOTSET:
        should_print = False
    app_name, app_id = self._parse_app_name_and_id(
        app_name=app_name, app_id_suffix=app_id_suffix, should_print=should_print
    )
    if secret_values is not NOTSET and secret_values is not None:
        env_from_secrets = [app_id] if secret_values else []
    else:
        secret_values = Configuration.SPARK_ON_K8S_SECRET_ENV_VAR
        env_from_secrets = [app_id] if secret_values else []
    if driver_ephemeral_configmaps_volumes is NOTSET:
        driver_ephemeral_configmaps_volumes = []
    if driver_env_vars_from_secrets is NOTSET:
        driver_env_vars_from_secrets = Configuration.SPARK_ON_K8S_DRIVER_ENV_VARS_FROM_SECRET
    if driver_env_vars_from_secrets:
        env_from_secrets.extend(driver_env_vars_from_secrets)
    if volumes is NOTSET or volumes is None:
        volumes = []
    if driver_volume_mounts is NOTSET or driver_volume_mounts is None:
        driver_volume_mounts = []
    if executor_volume_mounts is NOTSET or executor_volume_mounts is None:
        executor_volume_mounts = []
    volumes = list(volumes)
    driver_volume_mounts = list(driver_volume_mounts)
    executor_volume_mounts = list(executor_volume_mounts)
    if driver_node_selector is NOTSET or driver_node_selector is None:
        driver_node_selector = {}
    if executor_node_selector is NOTSET or executor_node_selector is None:
        executor_node_selector = {}
    if driver_annotations is NOTSET or driver_annotations is None:
        driver_annotations = {}
    if executor_annotations is NOTSET or executor_annotations is None:
        executor_annotations = {}
    if driver_labels is NOTSET or driver_labels is None:
        driver_labels = {}
    if executor_labels is NOTSET or executor_labels is None:
        executor_labels = {}
    if driver_tolerations is NOTSET or driver_tolerations is None:
        driver_tolerations = []
    if executor_pod_template_path is NOTSET or executor_pod_template_path is None:
        executor_pod_template_path = Configuration.SPARK_ON_K8S_EXECUTOR_POD_TEMPLATE_PATH
    if executor_pod_template is NOTSET or executor_pod_template is None:
        executor_pod_template = Configuration.SPARK_ON_K8S_EXECUTOR_TEMPLATE
    if startup_timeout is NOTSET:
        startup_timeout = Configuration.SPARK_ON_K8S_STARTUP_TIMEOUT
    if driver_init_containers is NOTSET:
        driver_init_containers = []
    if driver_host_aliases is NOTSET:
        driver_host_aliases = []

    spark_conf = spark_conf or {}
    driver_environment = self._driver_environment(spark_conf)
    main_class_parameters = app_arguments or []

    driver_resources = driver_resources or PodResources()
    executor_resources = executor_resources or PodResources()
    executor_instances = executor_instances or ExecutorInstances(initial=2)

    basic_conf = {
        "spark.app.name": app_name,
        "spark.app.id": app_id,
        "spark.kubernetes.namespace": namespace,
        "spark.kubernetes.authenticate.driver.serviceAccountName": service_account,
        "spark.kubernetes.container.image": image,
        "spark.driver.host": app_id,
        "spark.driver.port": "7077",
        "spark.kubernetes.driver.pod.name": SparkAppManager._get_pod_name(app_id=app_id),
        "spark.kubernetes.executor.podNamePrefix": app_id,
        "spark.kubernetes.container.image.pullPolicy": image_pull_policy,
        "spark.driver.memory": f"{driver_resources.memory}m",
        "spark.executor.cores": f"{executor_resources.cpu}",
        "spark.executor.memory": f"{executor_resources.memory}m",
        "spark.executor.memoryOverhead": f"{executor_resources.memory_overhead}m",
        **self._executor_secrets_config(secret_values=secret_values, app_id=app_id),
    }
    extra_labels = {}
    if ui_reverse_proxy:
        basic_conf["spark.ui.proxyBase"] = f"/webserver/ui/{namespace}/{app_id}"
        basic_conf["spark.ui.proxyRedirectUri"] = "/"
        extra_labels["spark-ui-proxy"] = "true"
    if executor_instances.min is not None or executor_instances.max is not None:
        basic_conf["spark.dynamicAllocation.enabled"] = "true"
        basic_conf["spark.dynamicAllocation.shuffleTracking.enabled"] = "true"
        basic_conf["spark.dynamicAllocation.minExecutors"] = f"{executor_instances.min or 0}"
        if executor_instances.max is not None:
            basic_conf["spark.dynamicAllocation.maxExecutors"] = f"{executor_instances.max}"
        basic_conf["spark.dynamicAllocation.initialExecutors"] = f"{executor_instances.initial or 0}"
        basic_conf["spark.dynamicAllocation.executorAllocationRatio"] = str(
            executor_instances.executor_allocation_ratio
        )
        basic_conf["spark.dynamicAllocation.schedulerBacklogTimeout"] = (
            executor_instances.scheduler_backlog_timeout
        )
        basic_conf["spark.dynamicAllocation.sustainedSchedulerBacklogTimeout"] = (
            executor_instances.sustained_scheduler_backlog_timeout
            or executor_instances.scheduler_backlog_timeout
        )
    else:
        basic_conf["spark.executor.instances"] = (
            f"{executor_instances.initial if executor_instances.initial is not None else 2}"
        )
    # Note: executor volume mounts will be processed after volumes are created
    if executor_node_selector:
        basic_conf.update(self._executor_node_selector(node_selector=executor_node_selector))
    if executor_labels:
        basic_conf.update(self._executor_labels(labels=executor_labels))
    if executor_annotations:
        basic_conf.update(self._executor_annotations(annotations=executor_annotations))
    # Handle executor template (either string content or local file path)
    executor_template_configmap = None
    if executor_pod_template and executor_pod_template_path:
        raise ValueError(
            "Both executor_pod_template and executor_pod_template_path are provided. "
            "Please provide only one of them."
        )

    if executor_pod_template:
        # Process the template (read from file if it's a path, otherwise use as content)
        template_content = self._process_executor_template(executor_pod_template)

        # ConfigMap names are reused as volume names, which are limited to 63 characters.
        template_configmap_name = f"{app_id}-executor-template"
        if len(template_configmap_name) > 63:
            # Hash the full ID so truncating the readable prefix preserves uniqueness.
            app_id_digest = hashlib.sha256(app_id.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:32]
            template_configmap_name = f"{app_id[:12]}-{app_id_digest}-executor-template"
        executor_template_configmap = {
            "name": template_configmap_name,
            "mount_path": "/opt/spark/executor-template",
            "sources": [{"name": "executor-template.yaml", "text": template_content}],
        }

        # Set Spark configuration to use the mounted template
        basic_conf.update(
            self._executor_pod_template_path("/opt/spark/executor-template/executor-template.yaml")
        )

    elif executor_pod_template_path:
        # Handle external executor pod template path (S3, GCS, etc.)
        basic_conf.update(self._executor_pod_template_path(executor_pod_template_path))

    # Process executor volume mounts before building driver command args
    if executor_volume_mounts:
        basic_conf.update(
            self._executor_volumes_config(volumes=volumes, volume_mounts=executor_volume_mounts)
        )

    driver_command_args = ["driver", "--master", "k8s://https://kubernetes.default.svc.cluster.local:443"]
    if class_name:
        driver_command_args.extend(["--class", class_name])
    if packages:
        driver_command_args.extend(["--packages", ",".join(packages)])
    driver_command_args.extend(
        self._spark_config_to_arguments({**basic_conf, **spark_conf}) + [app_path, *main_class_parameters]
    )

    all_configmaps = []
    if driver_ephemeral_configmaps_volumes:
        all_configmaps.extend(driver_ephemeral_configmaps_volumes)

    # Add executor template ConfigMap if present
    if executor_template_configmap:
        all_configmaps.append(executor_template_configmap)

    if all_configmaps:
        application_configmaps_volumes = self.app_manager.create_configmap_objects(
            app_name=app_name,
            app_id=app_id,
            configmaps=all_configmaps,
            namespace=namespace,
        )
        for ind, configmap in enumerate(application_configmaps_volumes):
            volumes.append(
                k8s.V1Volume(
                    name=configmap.metadata.name,
                    config_map=k8s.V1ConfigMapVolumeSource(name=configmap.metadata.name),
                )
            )

            configmap_mount_path = all_configmaps[ind]["mount_path"]
            driver_volume_mounts.append(
                k8s.V1VolumeMount(
                    name=configmap.metadata.name,
                    mount_path=configmap_mount_path,
                )
            )
    else:
        application_configmaps_volumes = []

    pod = SparkAppManager.create_spark_pod_spec(
        app_name=app_name,
        app_id=app_id,
        image=image,
        image_pull_policy=image_pull_policy,
        namespace=namespace,
        service_account=service_account,
        args=driver_command_args,
        env_variables=driver_environment,
        extra_labels={
            **{key: value for key, value in driver_labels.items() if key != "spark-ui-proxy"},
            **extra_labels,
            "spark-app-name": app_name,
            "spark-app-id": app_id,
            "spark-role": "driver",
        },
        annotations=driver_annotations,
        pod_resources={
            "requests": {
                "cpu": f"{driver_resources.cpu}",
                "memory": f"{driver_resources.memory + driver_resources.memory_overhead}Mi",
            },
            "limits": {
                "cpu": f"{driver_resources.cpu}",
                "memory": f"{driver_resources.memory + driver_resources.memory_overhead}Mi",
            },
        },
        env_from_secrets=env_from_secrets,
        volumes=volumes,
        volume_mounts=driver_volume_mounts,
        node_selector=driver_node_selector,
        tolerations=driver_tolerations,
        init_containers=driver_init_containers,
        host_aliases=driver_host_aliases,
    )
    if template is not None:
        pod = merge_driver_pod_template(pod, template, driver_container_name)
    if dry_run:
        objects = [("ConfigMap", item) for item in application_configmaps_volumes]
        if secret_values:
            objects.insert(
                0,
                (
                    "Secret",
                    self.app_manager.create_secret_object(
                        app_name=app_name,
                        app_id=app_id,
                        secrets_values=secret_values,
                        namespace=namespace,
                    ),
                ),
            )
        objects.extend(
            [
                ("Pod", pod),
                (
                    "Service",
                    SparkAppManager.create_headless_service_object(
                        app_name=app_name, app_id=app_id, namespace=namespace, extra_labels=extra_labels
                    ),
                ),
            ]
        )
        with k8s.ApiClient() as serializer:
            resources = tuple(
                {**serializer.sanitize_for_serialization(item), "apiVersion": "v1", "kind": kind}
                for kind, item in objects
            )
        pod_name = pod["metadata"]["name"] if isinstance(pod, dict) else pod.metadata.name
        from spark_on_k8s.resource_plan import resource_envelope

        planned_pod = next(item for item in resources if item["kind"] == "Pod")
        return ApplicationPlan(
            namespace,
            app_id,
            pod_name,
            resources,
            resource_envelope(planned_pod, {**basic_conf, **spark_conf}),
        )
    self.last_submission_phase = "creating_resources"
    with self.k8s_client_manager.client() as client:
        api = k8s.CoreV1Api(client)
        if secret_values:
            application_secret = self.app_manager.create_secret_object(
                app_name=app_name,
                app_id=app_id,
                secrets_values=secret_values,
                namespace=namespace,
            )
            api.create_namespaced_secret(namespace=namespace, body=application_secret)
        for configmap in application_configmaps_volumes:
            api.create_namespaced_config_map(namespace=namespace, body=configmap)
        pod = api.create_namespaced_pod(
            namespace=namespace,
            body=pod,
        )
        # Preserve the confirmed driver identity before later resource operations can fail.
        self.last_submitted_app_id = app_id
        self.last_submitted_run = RunHandle(
            namespace=namespace, app_id=app_id, driver_pod=pod.metadata.name, driver_uid=pod.metadata.uid
        )
        self.last_submission_phase = "driver_created"
        if secret_values:
            application_secret.metadata.owner_references = [
                k8s.V1OwnerReference(
                    api_version="v1",
                    kind="Pod",
                    name=pod.metadata.name,
                    uid=pod.metadata.uid,
                )
            ]
            api.patch_namespaced_secret(
                namespace=namespace,
                name=application_secret.metadata.name,
                body=application_secret,
            )
        for configmap in application_configmaps_volumes:
            configmap.metadata.owner_references = [
                k8s.V1OwnerReference(
                    api_version="v1",
                    kind="Pod",
                    name=pod.metadata.name,
                    uid=pod.metadata.uid,
                )
            ]
            api.patch_namespaced_config_map(
                namespace=namespace,
                name=configmap.metadata.name,
                body=configmap,
            )
        api.create_namespaced_service(
            namespace=namespace,
            body=SparkAppManager.create_headless_service_object(
                app_name=app_name,
                app_id=app_id,
                namespace=namespace,
                pod_owner_uid=pod.metadata.uid,
                extra_labels=extra_labels,
            ),
        )
    self.last_submission_phase = "resources_created"
    deadline = WaitDeadline(wait_timeout)
    if app_waiter == SparkAppWait.LOG:
        self.app_manager.stream_logs(
            namespace=namespace,
            pod_name=pod.metadata.name,
            startup_timeout=startup_timeout,
            should_print=should_print,
            **({"timeout": deadline.remaining()} if wait_timeout is not None else {}),
        )
    if app_waiter == SparkAppWait.WAIT or (app_waiter == SparkAppWait.LOG and wait_timeout is not None):
        self.app_manager.wait_for_app(
            namespace=namespace,
            pod_name=pod.metadata.name,
            poll_interval=5,
            startup_timeout=startup_timeout,
            should_print=should_print,
            **({"timeout": deadline.remaining()} if wait_timeout is not None else {}),
        )
    return pod.metadata.name

def submit_run(self, **kwargs) -> RunHandle:
    """Submit using the same arguments as submit_app, returning a structured run identity."""
    if kwargs.get("dry_run"):
        raise ValueError("submit_run requires a real submission and does not support dry_run")
    self.submit_app(**kwargs)
    if self.last_submitted_run is None:
        raise RuntimeError("Submission completed without a run identity")
    return self.last_submitted_run

Exactly one of sql and sql_file is required. Other keyword arguments are passed to :meth:submit_app, including image, resources, namespace, service account, packages, and waiter options. SQL runs in statement order; the first failed statement fails the application. This is not a transaction. Set dry_run=True to return an offline :class:ApplicationPlan instead of submitting.

Source code in spark_on_k8s/client.py 
def submit_sql(
    self,
    *,
    sql: str | None = None,
    sql_file: str | Path | None = None,
    **submit_options: Any,
) -> str | ApplicationPlan:
    """Submit inline SQL or a local SQL file using a PySpark image.

    Exactly one of ``sql`` and ``sql_file`` is required. Other keyword arguments
    are passed to :meth:`submit_app`, including image, resources, namespace,
    service account, packages, and waiter options. SQL runs in statement order;
    the first failed statement fails the application. This is not a transaction.
    Set ``dry_run=True`` to return an offline :class:`ApplicationPlan` instead of submitting.
    """
    from spark_on_k8s.sql import prepare_sql_options

    return self.submit_app(**prepare_sql_options(sql=sql, sql_file=sql_file, **submit_options))

def default_app_id_suffix() -> str:
    """Default function to generate a suffix for the application ID

    Returns:
        the current timestamp in the format %Y%m%d%H%M%S prefixed with a dash (e.g. -20240101123456)

@dataclass(frozen=True, kw_only=True)
class ConnectProfile:
    """Connection to an existing Spark Connect service; no cluster is created."""

    endpoint: str
    tls: bool = True
    token_env: str | None = None
    user_id: str | None = None
    allow_insecure: bool = False

    def __post_init__(self):
        if not isinstance(self.endpoint, str) or any(c.isspace() for c in self.endpoint):
            raise ConnectError("endpoint must be a Spark Connect URL without whitespace.")
        try:
            url = urlsplit(self.endpoint)
            port = url.port
        except ValueError:
            raise ConnectError("Invalid Spark Connect endpoint.") from None
        if (
            url.scheme != "sc"
            or not url.hostname
            or url.username is not None
            or url.password is not None
            or url.path not in {"", "/"}
            or url.query
            or url.fragment
            or ";" in self.endpoint
            or port == 0
        ):
            raise ConnectError("Use sc://host:port without credentials, parameters, query, or path.")
        if type(self.tls) is not bool or type(self.allow_insecure) is not bool:
            raise ConnectError("tls and allow_insecure must be booleans.")
        try:
            loopback = ipaddress.ip_address(url.hostname).is_loopback
        except ValueError:
            loopback = url.hostname.lower() == "localhost"
        if not self.tls and not loopback and not self.allow_insecure:
            raise ConnectError("Remote endpoints require TLS; use allow_insecure only on a trusted network.")
        if self.token_env is not None and (
            not isinstance(self.token_env, str) or not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*", self.token_env)
        ):
            raise ConnectError("token_env must name an environment variable.")
        if self.user_id is not None and (not isinstance(self.user_id, str) or not self.user_id):
            raise ConnectError("user_id must be a non-empty string.")

    @classmethod
    def from_file(cls, path: str | Path, *, profile: str = "default") -> ConnectProfile:
        with Path(path).expanduser().open("rb") as stream:
            content = stream.read(1024 * 1024 + 1)
        if len(content) > 1024 * 1024:
            raise ConnectError("Connect profile files must be no larger than 1 MiB.")
        try:
            document = tomllib.loads(content.decode("utf-8"))
        except (UnicodeError, tomllib.TOMLDecodeError):
            raise ConnectError("Invalid Connect profile TOML.") from None
        if set(document) != {"profiles"} or not isinstance(document["profiles"], dict):
            raise ConnectError("Expected a TOML [profiles.NAME] table.")
        values = document["profiles"].get(profile)
        if not isinstance(values, dict):
            raise ConnectError("The selected Connect profile does not exist.")
        if set(values) - set(cls.__dataclass_fields__) or "endpoint" not in values:
            raise ConnectError("Connect profile has missing or unsupported fields.")
        return cls(**values)

    def connection_string(self) -> str:
        """Build a private URI for PySpark. This return value may contain credentials."""
        url = self.endpoint.rstrip("/") + "/;use_ssl=" + str(self.tls).lower()
        if self.token_env:
            token = os.environ.get(self.token_env)
            if not token:
                raise ConnectError("The configured token environment variable is empty or missing.")
            url += ";token=" + quote(token, safe="")
        if self.user_id:
            url += ";user_id=" + quote(self.user_id, safe="")
        return url

    @contextmanager
    def session(self):
        """Create an independent session and attempt release without masking application failure."""
        connection = self.connection_string()
        try:
            from pyspark.sql.connect.session import SparkSession
        except ImportError:
            raise ConnectError(
                "Install spark-on-k8s[connect] on Python 3.11–3.14, or a matching pyspark[connect] client."
            ) from None
        try:
            session = SparkSession.builder.remote(connection).create()
        except Exception:
            raise ConnectError(
                "Could not open a Spark Connect session; check endpoint and credentials."
            ) from None
        try:
            yield session
        except BaseException as original:
            try:
                session.stop()
            except Exception:
                original.add_note("Spark Connect session release also failed; server expiry may be required.")
            raise
        else:
            try:
                session.stop()
            except Exception:
                raise ConnectError(
                    "Spark Connect session release failed; server expiry may be required."
                ) from None

    def probe(self, *, timeout: float = 15, expected_app_id: str | None = None) -> dict:
        """Execute a tiny remote query in a child process with a hard total timeout."""
        if type(timeout) not in {int, float} or not math.isfinite(timeout) or timeout <= 0:
            raise ConnectError("timeout must be a positive finite number of seconds.")
        if expected_app_id is not None and (
            not isinstance(expected_app_id, str)
            or not re.fullmatch(r"[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,62}", expected_app_id)
        ):
            raise ConnectError("expected_app_id must be a valid Spark application identifier")
        request = asdict(self)
        if expected_app_id is not None:
            request["expected_app_id"] = expected_app_id
        # Credentials remain in the environment/stdin, never process arguments or a temporary file.
        try:
            result = subprocess.run(
                [sys.executable, "-I", "-m", "spark_on_k8s.connect"],
                input=json.dumps(request),
                capture_output=True,
                text=True,
                timeout=timeout,
                check=False,
            )
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            raise TimeoutError("Spark Connect check timed out; the server was not stopped.") from None
        if result.returncode:
            try:
                error = json.loads(result.stdout)["error"]
            except (ValueError, KeyError, TypeError):
                error = _CHECK_ERROR
            raise ConnectError(error)
        try:
            payload = json.loads(result.stdout)
            if payload.get("schema_version") != 1 or payload.get("status") != "ok":
                raise ValueError
            if expected_app_id is not None and payload.get("app_id") != expected_app_id:
                raise ValueError
            return payload
        except (ValueError, AttributeError):
            raise ConnectError("Spark Connect check returned an invalid response.") from None

@dataclass(frozen=True, kw_only=True)
class ConnectServerConfig:
    """Explicit inputs for one private, single-driver Spark Connect server.

    The image must contain the specified Connect server JAR and a Spark entrypoint.
    This configuration creates neither namespaces nor service accounts. Its plaintext
    ClusterIP service requires a trusted network or a separately managed gateway.
    """

    image: str
    server_jar: str
    namespace: str
    service_account: str
    app_name: str = "spark-connect"
    port: int = 15002
    image_pull_policy: str = "IfNotPresent"
    driver_resources: PodResources = field(default_factory=PodResources)
    executor_resources: PodResources = field(default_factory=PodResources)
    executor_instances: ExecutorInstances = field(default_factory=ExecutorInstances)
    spark_conf: dict[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)
    packages: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    driver_node_selector: dict[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def __post_init__(self):
        if not isinstance(self.image, str) or not self.image or any(c.isspace() for c in self.image):
            raise ValueError("image must be an explicit nonblank container image")
        if (
            not isinstance(self.server_jar, str)
            or not self.server_jar.startswith("local:///")
            or not self.server_jar.endswith(".jar")
            or any(c.isspace() for c in self.server_jar)
        ):
            raise ValueError("server_jar must be an explicit local:/// path to a JAR in the image")
        _name(self.namespace, "namespace")
        _name(self.service_account, "service_account", max_length=253)
        if not isinstance(self.app_name, str) or not re.fullmatch(
            r"[a-z](?:[a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9])?", self.app_name
        ):
            raise ValueError("app_name must start with a lowercase letter and contain DNS-label characters")
        _port(self.port)
        if self.image_pull_policy not in {"Always", "IfNotPresent", "Never"}:
            raise ValueError("image_pull_policy must be Always, IfNotPresent, or Never")
        for name, resources in (("driver", self.driver_resources), ("executor", self.executor_resources)):
            if not isinstance(resources, PodResources):
                raise ValueError(f"{name}_resources must be PodResources")
            for key in ("cpu", "memory", "memory_overhead"):
                _positive(getattr(resources, key), f"{name}.{key}", zero=key == "memory_overhead")
        instances = self.executor_instances
        if not isinstance(instances, ExecutorInstances):
            raise ValueError("executor_instances must be ExecutorInstances")
        for key in ("min", "max", "initial"):
            value = getattr(instances, key)
            if value is not None:
                _positive(value, f"executor_instances.{key}", zero=key != "max")
        if instances.min is not None and instances.max is not None and instances.min > instances.max:
            raise ValueError("Minimum executors cannot exceed maximum executors")
        if instances.initial is not None and (
            (instances.min is not None and instances.initial < instances.min)
            or (instances.max is not None and instances.initial > instances.max)
        ):
            raise ValueError("Initial executors must be within the configured minimum and maximum")
        if (
            type(instances.executor_allocation_ratio) not in {int, float}
            or not math.isfinite(instances.executor_allocation_ratio)
            or not 0 < instances.executor_allocation_ratio <= 1
        ):
            raise ValueError("Executor allocation ratio must be finite and in (0, 1]")
        for value in (instances.scheduler_backlog_timeout, instances.sustained_scheduler_backlog_timeout):
            if value is not None and (
                not isinstance(value, str) or not re.fullmatch(r"[1-9][0-9]*(?:ms|s|m|h|d)?", value)
            ):
                raise ValueError("Executor backlog timeouts must be positive Spark durations")
        for name, values in (
            ("spark_conf", self.spark_conf),
            ("driver_node_selector", self.driver_node_selector),
        ):
            if not isinstance(values, dict) or any(
                not isinstance(k, str) or not k or not isinstance(v, str) for k, v in values.items()
            ):
                raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a string-to-string mapping")
        if any(
            (key in _PROTECTED_CONF or key.startswith(_PROTECTED_PREFIXES))
            and key != "spark.kubernetes.executor.request.cores"
            for key in self.spark_conf
        ):
            raise ValueError(
                "spark_conf cannot override managed identity, ports, images, resources, or allocation"
            )
        request_cores = self.spark_conf.get("spark.kubernetes.executor.request.cores")
        if request_cores is not None:
            if not re.fullmatch(r"(?:[0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?|\.[0-9]+)m?", request_cores):
                raise ValueError("Executor CPU request must be a positive Kubernetes CPU quantity")
            amount = float(request_cores.removesuffix("m")) / (1000 if request_cores.endswith("m") else 1)
            if not math.isfinite(amount) or amount <= 0 or amount > self.executor_resources.cpu:
                raise ValueError(
                    "Executor CPU request must be positive and no greater than configured executor cores"
                )
        if not isinstance(self.packages, list) or any(
            not isinstance(p, str) or not re.fullmatch(r"[^\s,:]+:[^\s,:]+:[^\s,:]+", p)
            for p in self.packages
        ):
            raise ValueError("packages must contain explicit Maven group:artifact:version coordinates")

@dataclass(frozen=True, kw_only=True)
class ConnectServerHandle:
    """Credential-free identity for a server and both owned Kubernetes Services."""

    run: RunHandle
    service_name: str
    service_uid: str
    driver_service_uid: str
    port: int

    def __post_init__(self):
        if not isinstance(self.run, RunHandle):
            raise ValueError("run must be a RunHandle")
        _name(self.run.namespace, "namespace")
        _name(self.run.app_id, "app_id")
        _name(self.run.driver_pod, "driver_pod", max_length=253)
        _name(self.service_name, "service_name")
        if (
            self.run.driver_pod != f"{self.run.app_id}-driver"
            or self.service_name != f"{self.run.app_id}-connect"
        ):
            raise ValueError("Connect resource names must match the recorded application identity")
        for value in (self.run.driver_uid, self.service_uid, self.driver_service_uid):
            _uid(value)
        _port(self.port)

    @property
    def endpoint(self) -> str:
        """Return the private cluster DNS endpoint; no credentials are included."""
        return f"sc://{self.service_name}.{self.run.namespace}.svc:{self.port}"

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "run": self.run.to_dict(),
            "service_name": self.service_name,
            "service_uid": self.service_uid,
            "driver_service_uid": self.driver_service_uid,
            "port": self.port,
        }

    @classmethod
    def from_dict(cls, value: dict) -> ConnectServerHandle:
        if not isinstance(value, dict) or set(value) != {
            "run",
            "service_name",
            "service_uid",
            "driver_service_uid",
            "port",
        }:
            raise ValueError("Invalid Connect server receipt fields")
        run = value["run"]
        if not isinstance(run, dict) or set(run) != {"namespace", "app_id", "driver_pod", "driver_uid"}:
            raise ValueError("Connect server receipt requires complete run identity")
        return cls(**{**value, "run": RunHandle(**run)})

def connect_server_status(client: SparkOnK8S, handle: ConnectServerHandle, *, timeout: float = 10) -> dict:
    """Read matching resource state. Only confirmed 404 means missing; errors propagate."""
    if not isinstance(handle, ConnectServerHandle):
        raise ValueError("handle must be ConnectServerHandle")
    deadline = _deadline(timeout)
    with client.k8s_client_manager.client() as raw:
        pod, transport, service = _resources(_api(raw), handle, deadline)
    missing = [
        name
        for name, obj in (("driver", pod), ("driver_service", transport), ("connect_service", service))
        if obj is None
    ]
    phase = pod.status.phase if pod is not None and pod.status else None
    deleting = any(
        obj is not None and obj.metadata.deletion_timestamp is not None for obj in (pod, transport, service)
    )
    state = (
        "missing"
        if missing
        else "deleting"
        if deleting
        else "terminated"
        if phase in {"Succeeded", "Failed"}
        else "running"
        if phase == "Running"
        else "starting"
        if phase == "Pending"
        else "unknown"
    )
    return {
        "status": state,
        "driver_phase": phase,
        "missing": missing,
        "endpoint": handle.endpoint,
        "query_ready": None,
        "message": "Kubernetes observation only; query readiness has not been checked",
    }

def create_connect_server(client: SparkOnK8S, config: ConnectServerConfig) -> ConnectServerHandle:
    """Create a driver and private gRPC Service, without claiming query readiness.

    A failed create attempts rollback only after receiving a confirmed driver UID.
    A timeout with no confirmed UID is uncertain: no retry, adoption or deletion occurs.
    The raised error retains the planned/confirmed run and rollback outcome.
    """
    if not isinstance(config, ConnectServerConfig):
        raise ValueError("config must be ConnectServerConfig")
    config = deepcopy(config)
    config.__post_init__()  # Nested resource/mapping objects may have changed since construction.
    token = uuid4().hex
    options = _options(config, token)
    app_id = f"{options['app_name']}-{token}"
    planned = RunHandle(namespace=config.namespace, app_id=app_id, driver_pod=f"{app_id}-driver")
    run = None
    handle = None
    phase = "driver_submission"
    try:
        run = client.submit_run(**options)
        _uid(run.driver_uid)
        phase = "driver_service_verification"
        with client.k8s_client_manager.client() as raw:
            api = _api(raw)
            deadline = WaitDeadline(10)
            pod = _read(api, "pod", run.driver_pod, run.namespace, deadline)
            transport = _read(api, "service", run.app_id, run.namespace, deadline)
            _driver(run, pod)
            _service(run, transport, name=run.app_id, uid=None)
            if pod is None or transport is None:
                raise ConnectServerError("Submitted Connect driver or driver Service is missing", run=run)
            phase = "grpc_service_creation"
            labels = {"spark-app-id": run.app_id, "spark-role": "driver", _SERVER_LABEL: "true"}
            name = f"{run.app_id}-connect"
            body = k8s.V1Service(
                metadata=k8s.V1ObjectMeta(
                    name=name,
                    namespace=run.namespace,
                    labels=labels,
                    owner_references=[
                        k8s.V1OwnerReference(
                            api_version="v1", kind="Pod", name=run.driver_pod, uid=run.driver_uid
                        )
                    ],
                ),
                spec=k8s.V1ServiceSpec(
                    type="ClusterIP",
                    selector=labels,
                    ports=[
                        k8s.V1ServicePort(
                            name="grpc", port=config.port, target_port=config.port, protocol="TCP"
                        )
                    ],
                ),
            )
            service = api.create_namespaced_service(
                namespace=run.namespace, body=body, **deadline.request_options()
            )
            handle = ConnectServerHandle(
                run=run,
                service_name=name,
                service_uid=service.metadata.uid,
                driver_service_uid=transport.metadata.uid,
                port=config.port,
            )
            _service(run, service, name=name, uid=handle.service_uid, port=config.port)
        return handle
    except Exception as exc:
        confirmed = run or client.last_submitted_run
        if confirmed is not None and (
            confirmed.namespace != planned.namespace
            or confirmed.app_id != planned.app_id
            or confirmed.driver_pod != planned.driver_pod
        ):
            confirmed = None
        cleanup = {"status": "not_attempted", "reason": "Driver creation is unconfirmed; resources may exist"}
        if confirmed is not None and confirmed.driver_uid:
            try:
                client.cancel_run(confirmed)
                cleanup = {
                    "status": "requested",
                    "reason": (
                        "UID-checked driver deletion requested; owned resources "
                        "are garbage-collected asynchronously"
                    ),
                }
            except KeyboardInterrupt as interrupted:
                interrupted.handle = handle
                interrupted.run = confirmed
                interrupted.phase = "rollback"
                interrupted.cleanup = {
                    "status": "unknown",
                    "reason": "Rollback was interrupted; deletion may already have been requested",
                }
                raise
            except Exception:
                cleanup = {
                    "status": "failed",
                    "reason": "UID-checked rollback failed; inspect the recorded run before retrying cleanup",
                }
        raise ConnectServerCreateError(
            "Spark Connect server creation failed",
            handle=handle,
            run=confirmed or planned,
            phase=phase,
            cleanup=cleanup,
        ) from exc

def delete_connect_server(client: SparkOnK8S, handle: ConnectServerHandle, *, timeout: float = 10) -> dict:
    """Verify all three resource identities before requesting UID-conditional deletion.

    Missing resources are idempotent. Success means deletion was requested, not that
    executors or Services have already disappeared. A concurrent change can interrupt
    a partially applied deletion; UID preconditions protect replacement resources.
    """
    if not isinstance(handle, ConnectServerHandle):
        raise ValueError("handle must be ConnectServerHandle")
    deadline = _deadline(timeout)
    requested = []
    with client.k8s_client_manager.client() as raw:
        api = _api(raw)
        pod, transport, service = _resources(api, handle, deadline)
        for kind, obj in (("service", service), ("service", transport), ("pod", pod)):
            if obj is None:
                continue
            try:
                getattr(api, f"delete_namespaced_{kind}")(
                    name=obj.metadata.name,
                    namespace=handle.run.namespace,
                    body=k8s.V1DeleteOptions(
                        propagation_policy="Foreground",
                        preconditions=k8s.V1Preconditions(uid=obj.metadata.uid),
                    ),
                    **deadline.request_options(),
                )
            except ApiException as exc:
                if exc.status != 404:
                    raise
            requested.append({"kind": kind, "name": obj.metadata.name, "uid": obj.metadata.uid})
    return {
        "status": "deletion_requested" if requested else "absent",
        "requested": requested,
        "message": "Resource deletion and executor garbage collection are asynchronous",
    }

def wait_connect_server_ready(
    client: SparkOnK8S,
    handle: ConnectServerHandle,
    *,
    profile: ConnectProfile,
    timeout: float = 60,
    poll_interval: float = 1,
) -> dict:
    """Require a real query against this application, then revalidate Kubernetes identity."""
    if not isinstance(profile, ConnectProfile):
        raise ValueError("profile must be a reachable ConnectProfile")
    if type(poll_interval) not in {int, float} or not math.isfinite(poll_interval) or poll_interval <= 0:
        raise ValueError("poll_interval must be positive and finite")
    deadline = _deadline(timeout)
    try:
        while True:
            status = connect_server_status(client, handle, timeout=deadline.remaining())
            if status["status"] in {"missing", "deleting", "terminated"}:
                raise ConnectServerError(
                    "Connect server is missing, terminating, or terminated", handle=handle, phase="readiness"
                )
            if status["status"] == "running":
                try:
                    result = profile.probe(
                        timeout=min(5, deadline.remaining()), expected_app_id=handle.run.app_id
                    )
                except (ConnectError, TimeoutError):
                    pass
                else:
                    after = connect_server_status(client, handle, timeout=deadline.remaining())
                    if after["status"] == "running":
                        return {
                            **after,
                            "status": "ready",
                            "query_ready": True,
                            "probe": result,
                            "message": "Connect query and application identity verified",
                        }
            deadline.sleep(poll_interval)
    except TimeoutError:
        raise ConnectServerTimeout(handle) from None
    except (TransportTimeoutError, MaxRetryError) as error:
        # urllib3 can wrap a request timeout once the remaining wait budget is tiny.
        # Only the enclosing deadline expiring changes that transport error into a wait timeout.
        reason = error.reason if isinstance(error, MaxRetryError) else error
        if isinstance(reason, TransportTimeoutError) and not isinstance(reason, NewConnectionError):
            try:
                deadline.remaining()
            except TimeoutError:
                raise ConnectServerTimeout(handle) from None
        raise

def classify_pod(pod: dict, events: list[dict]) -> list[DiagnosticFinding]:
    """Classify observed pod/container states and events; never inspect logs or secrets."""
    name = pod["metadata"]["name"]
    status = pod.get("status") or {}
    findings: dict[tuple[str, str | None], DiagnosticFinding] = {}

    def add(code, summary, evidence, remediation, container=None, severity="error"):
        findings.setdefault(
            (code, container),
            DiagnosticFinding(
                code,
                severity,
                name,
                summary,
                _evidence(evidence),
                remediation,
                container,
            ),
        )

    for container in (status.get("init_container_statuses") or []) + (status.get("container_statuses") or []):
        container_name = container.get("name")
        current = container.get("state") or {}
        waiting = current.get("waiting") or {}
        reason = waiting.get("reason")
        if reason in {"ImagePullBackOff", "ErrImagePull", "InvalidImageName"}:
            add(
                "image_pull_failed",
                "Container image is unavailable",
                waiting.get("message") or reason,
                "Check the image reference, registry reachability and imagePullSecrets in this namespace.",
                container_name,
            )
        if reason == "CrashLoopBackOff":
            add(
                "crash_loop",
                "Container repeatedly exits",
                waiting.get("message") or reason,
                "Inspect current and previous container logs and its exit code before changing "
                "restart or resource settings.",
                container_name,
            )
        for previous, state in ((False, current), (True, container.get("last_state") or {})):
            terminated = state.get("terminated") or {}
            if terminated.get("reason") == "OOMKilled":
                add(
                    "oom_killed",
                    "A container attempt was killed for exceeding memory",
                    f"{'Previous' if previous else 'Current'} attempt: OOMKilled; "
                    f"exit code {terminated.get('exit_code')}",
                    "Compare memory usage with the container limit and Spark memory/overhead "
                    "settings; investigate before increasing limits.",
                    container_name,
                    "warning" if previous else "error",
                )
            elif not previous and terminated.get("exit_code") not in (None, 0):
                add(
                    "container_failed",
                    "Container exited unsuccessfully",
                    f"{terminated.get('reason') or 'Terminated'}; exit code {terminated['exit_code']}",
                    "Inspect this container's logs for the application error. The exit code alone "
                    "does not identify the cause.",
                    container_name,
                )
    messages = [(event.get("reason", ""), event.get("message", "")) for event in events]
    messages.extend(
        (condition.get("reason", ""), condition.get("message", ""))
        for condition in status.get("conditions") or []
        if condition.get("type") == "PodScheduled" and condition.get("status") == "False"
    )
    for reason, message in messages:
        message = message or ""
        lower = message.lower()
        if reason in {"FailedScheduling", "Unschedulable"}:
            add(
                "unschedulable",
                "Kubernetes could not schedule the pod",
                message or reason,
                "Review the scheduler's stated constraints, resource requests, node selectors and affinity.",
            )
            if "insufficient " in lower:
                add(
                    "insufficient_resources",
                    "Scheduler reports insufficient resources",
                    message,
                    "Compare requested resources with eligible node capacity; adjust requests or "
                    "add capacity.",
                )
            if "taint" in lower:
                add(
                    "taint_mismatch",
                    "Scheduler reports a taint constraint",
                    message,
                    "Check whether the workload belongs on these nodes before adding a matching toleration.",
                )
        if "persistentvolumeclaim" in lower and ("not found" in lower or "unbound" in lower):
            add(
                "pvc_missing",
                "A required persistent volume claim is unavailable",
                message,
                "Check the named PVC in this namespace, its binding state and storage class. Do "
                "not create an empty replacement for required data.",
            )
        if "forbidden" in lower or reason == "Forbidden":
            add(
                "permission_denied",
                "Kubernetes reported a denied operation",
                message or reason,
                "Identify the denied verb/resource and acting service account in the evidence; "
                "ask an administrator for a namespace-scoped permission.",
            )
        if reason in {"FailedToRetrieveImagePullSecret"} or "failed to pull image" in lower:
            add(
                "image_pull_failed",
                "Kubernetes could not access the container image",
                message or reason,
                "Check the image reference, registry reachability and imagePullSecrets in this namespace.",
            )
    if not findings and status.get("phase") in {"Pending", "Failed"}:
        add(
            "cause_unknown",
            f"Pod is {status['phase']} without a specific observed cause",
            status.get("message") or status.get("reason") or f"Pod phase: {status['phase']}",
            "Inspect container logs and newer Kubernetes events. Absence of diagnostic evidence "
            "does not establish a cause.",
            severity="warning",
        )
    return list(findings.values())

def collect_diagnosis(api, driver, *, namespace: str, pod_limit=20, event_limit=100, timeout=10) -> Diagnosis:
    """Collect at most one executor page and one event page per inspected pod."""
    from kubernetes.client import ApiException
    from urllib3.exceptions import TimeoutError as HTTPTimeoutError

    deadline = _limits(pod_limit, event_limit, timeout)
    report = _report(driver, namespace)
    pods = [driver]
    try:
        response = api.list_namespaced_pod(
            **_executor_options(driver, report, pod_limit), **deadline.request_options()
        )
        pods.extend(_owned_executors(driver, response, report))
    except (ApiException, TimeoutError, HTTPTimeoutError) as error:
        _incomplete(
            report,
            driver.metadata.name,
            f"Executor listing failed ({getattr(error, 'status', 'timeout')}).",
            remediation=_read_remediation(error),
        )
    for pod in pods:
        response = None
        try:
            if not pod.metadata.uid:
                raise ValueError("Pod UID is unavailable")
            response = api.list_namespaced_event(
                **_event_options(pod, namespace, event_limit), **deadline.request_options()
            )
        except (ApiException, TimeoutError, HTTPTimeoutError, ValueError) as error:
            _incomplete(
                report,
                pod.metadata.name,
                f"Event listing failed ({getattr(error, 'status', 'unavailable')}).",
                remediation=_read_remediation(error),
            )
        _record(report, pod, response)
    return report

def check_cluster(client, *, namespace: str, service_account: str, timeout: float = 10) -> DoctorReport:
    """Read service-account metadata and perform non-persistent self-access reviews."""
    validate_target(namespace, service_account)
    if timeout is None or timeout <= 0 or timeout > 30:
        raise ValueError("timeout must be between 0 (exclusive) and 30 seconds")
    deadline = WaitDeadline(timeout)
    report = DoctorReport(namespace, service_account)
    api, authorization = k8s.CoreV1Api(client), k8s.AuthorizationV1Api(client)
    try:
        account = api.read_namespaced_service_account(
            name=service_account,
            namespace=namespace,
            **deadline.request_options(),
        )
        report.findings.append(
            DiagnosticFinding(
                "service_account_found",
                "info",
                service_account,
                "Driver service account exists",
                f"ServiceAccount {namespace}/{account.metadata.name}",
                "Existence does not establish its permissions; ask an administrator to review the "
                "scoped driver role.",
            )
        )
        if account.automount_service_account_token is False:
            report.findings.append(
                DiagnosticFinding(
                    "service_account_token_disabled",
                    "warning",
                    service_account,
                    "Automatic API credentials are disabled",
                    "ServiceAccount automountServiceAccountToken is false.",
                    "Confirm that the driver receives an explicit projected token or another "
                    "supported Kubernetes credential.",
                )
            )
    except (k8s.ApiException, TimeoutError, HTTPTimeoutError) as error:
        code = getattr(error, "status", "timeout")
        report.findings.append(
            DiagnosticFinding(
                "service_account_unavailable",
                "warning",
                service_account,
                "Driver service account could not be verified",
                f"Service-account lookup returned {code}.",
                "Check the namespace and service-account name, and the caller's permission to "
                "read serviceaccounts.",
            )
        )
    for resource, verb in CALLER_CHECKS:
        name, _, subresource = resource.partition("/")
        check = {"resource": resource, "verb": verb, "allowed": None}
        try:
            review = authorization.create_self_subject_access_review(
                body=k8s.V1SelfSubjectAccessReview(
                    spec=k8s.V1SelfSubjectAccessReviewSpec(
                        resource_attributes=k8s.V1ResourceAttributes(
                            namespace=namespace,
                            group="",
                            resource=name,
                            subresource=subresource or None,
                            verb=verb,
                        ),
                    )
                ),
                **deadline.request_options(),
            )
            check["allowed"] = bool(review.status.allowed) if review.status else None
        except (k8s.ApiException, TimeoutError, HTTPTimeoutError):
            pass
        report.caller_permissions.append(check)
        if check["allowed"] is not True:
            report.findings.append(
                DiagnosticFinding(
                    "caller_permission_denied" if check["allowed"] is False else "caller_permission_unknown",
                    "warning",
                    resource,
                    f"Caller permission: {verb} {resource}",
                    "Denied by Kubernetes authorization."
                    if check["allowed"] is False
                    else "Access review unavailable.",
                    "Review the caller's namespace-scoped role. These checks do not test or grant "
                    "driver service-account permissions.",
                )
            )
    return report

def driver_rbac(namespace: str, service_account: str) -> list[dict]:
    """Render a namespace-scoped baseline driver role; never apply it."""
    validate_target(namespace, service_account)
    role_name = f"{service_account}-spark-driver"
    if len(role_name) > 253:
        digest = sha256(service_account.encode()).hexdigest()[:10]
        role_name = f"{service_account[:229]}-{digest}-spark-driver"
    return [
        {
            "apiVersion": "rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1",
            "kind": "Role",
            "metadata": {"name": role_name, "namespace": namespace},
            "rules": [
                {
                    "apiGroups": [""],
                    "resources": ["pods"],
                    "verbs": ["get", "list", "watch", "create", "patch", "delete"],
                },
                {
                    "apiGroups": [""],
                    "resources": ["services", "configmaps"],
                    "verbs": ["get", "list", "watch", "create", "delete", "deletecollection"],
                },
            ],
        },
        {
            "apiVersion": "rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1",
            "kind": "RoleBinding",
            "metadata": {"name": role_name, "namespace": namespace},
            "subjects": [{"kind": "ServiceAccount", "name": service_account, "namespace": namespace}],
            "roleRef": {"apiGroup": "rbac.authorization.k8s.io", "kind": "Role", "name": role_name},
        },
    ]

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class JobSpec:
    """Validated effective job settings, independent of Airflow and the HTTP API."""

    name: str
    spec: dict[str, Any]
    kubernetes: dict[str, Any]
    profile: str | None = None

    @classmethod
    def from_mapping(cls, document: dict, *, profile: str | None = None) -> JobSpec:
        _object(document, {"apiVersion", "kind", "metadata", "spec", "kubernetes", "profiles"}, "job")
        if document.get("apiVersion") != API_VERSION or document.get("kind") != "SparkJob":
            raise JobValidationError(f"Expected apiVersion: {API_VERSION} and kind: SparkJob.")
        metadata = _object(document.get("metadata", {}), {"name"}, "metadata")
        name = metadata.get("name")
        _text(name, "metadata.name")
        if len(name) > 63 or not _DNS_NAME.fullmatch(name) or not name[0].isalpha():
            raise JobValidationError(
                "metadata.name must start with a letter and be a DNS label of at most 63 characters."
            )
        profiles = _object(document.get("profiles", {}), None, "profiles")
        for overlay in profiles.values():
            _object(overlay, {"spec", "kubernetes"}, "profile")
        resolved = copy.deepcopy(document)
        if profile is not None:
            if profile not in profiles:
                raise JobValidationError(f"Unknown profile: {profile}.")
            resolved = _merge(resolved, profiles[profile])
        spec = _object(resolved.get("spec", {}), _FIELDS, "spec")
        _validate_spec(spec)
        connection = _object(
            resolved.get("kubernetes", {}), {"context", "config_file", "in_cluster"}, "kubernetes"
        )
        for field in {"context", "config_file"} & connection.keys():
            _text(connection[field], f"kubernetes.{field}")
        if "in_cluster" in connection and type(connection["in_cluster"]) is not bool:
            raise JobValidationError("kubernetes.in_cluster must be a boolean.")
        if connection.get("in_cluster") and ("context" in connection or "config_file" in connection):
            raise JobValidationError(
                "In-cluster authentication cannot be combined with a kubeconfig/context."
            )
        return cls(name, copy.deepcopy(spec), copy.deepcopy(connection), profile)

    @classmethod
    def from_file(cls, path: str | Path, *, profile: str | None = None) -> JobSpec:
        path, document = cls._read_file(path)
        result = cls.from_mapping(document, profile=profile)
        for field in ("driver_pod_template", "executor_pod_template"):
            value = result.spec.get(field)
            if isinstance(value, str) and "\n" not in value and value.endswith((".yaml", ".yml")):
                template_path = Path(value).expanduser()
                if not template_path.is_absolute():
                    template_path = path.parent / template_path
                result.spec[field] = template_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        if "config_file" in result.kubernetes:
            config_path = Path(result.kubernetes["config_file"]).expanduser()
            if not config_path.is_absolute():
                config_path = path.parent / config_path
            result.kubernetes["config_file"] = str(config_path)
        return result

    @staticmethod
    def _read_file(path):
        path = Path(path).expanduser().resolve()
        with path.open("rb") as stream:
            content = stream.read(MAX_JOB_BYTES + 1)
        if len(content) > MAX_JOB_BYTES:
            raise JobValidationError("Job files must be no larger than 1 MiB.")
        try:
            document = yaml.load(content, Loader=_UniqueLoader)
        except yaml.YAMLError as error:
            raise JobValidationError("Invalid job YAML.") from error
        return path, document

    @classmethod
    def validate_profiles(cls, path: str | Path) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        """Validate the base and every named profile offline, reporting every failure."""
        _, document = cls._read_file(path)
        _object(document, None, "job")
        profiles = _object(document.get("profiles", {}), None, "profiles")
        results = []
        for profile in [None, *sorted(profiles)]:
            try:
                cls.from_file(path, profile=profile).plan()
            except (ValueError, TypeError, OSError) as error:
                results.append({"profile": profile, "valid": False, "error": str(error)})
            else:
                results.append({"profile": profile, "valid": True, "error": None})
        return results

    def to_submit_kwargs(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        _validate_spec(self.spec)
        # Job files are portable: ambient CLI defaults must not change their meaning.
        options = {
            "namespace": "default",
            "service_account": "spark",
            "spark_conf": {},
            "class_name": None,
            "packages": [],
            "app_arguments": [],
            "app_waiter": "no_wait",
            "image_pull_policy": "IfNotPresent",
            "ui_reverse_proxy": False,
            "driver_resources": {},
            "executor_resources": {},
            "executor_instances": {"initial": 2},
            "executor_pod_template": "",
            "executor_pod_template_path": "",
            "secret_values": {},
            "driver_env_vars_from_secrets": [],
            "startup_timeout": 0,
            "driver_node_selector": {},
            "executor_node_selector": {},
            "driver_labels": {},
            "executor_labels": {},
            "driver_annotations": {},
            "executor_annotations": {},
            **copy.deepcopy(self.spec),
        }
        options["app_name"] = self.name
        for field in _RESOURCE_FIELDS & options.keys():
            options[field] = PodResources(**options[field])
        if "executor_instances" in options:
            instances = options["executor_instances"]
            instances.setdefault(
                "initial", instances.get("min", 0) if {"min", "max"} & instances.keys() else 2
            )
            options["executor_instances"] = ExecutorInstances(**instances)
        if isinstance(options.get("executor_pod_template"), dict):
            options["executor_pod_template"] = yaml.safe_dump(options["executor_pod_template"])
        return options

    def to_operator_kwargs(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """Use the same settings in Airflow; choose Kubernetes credentials through an Airflow connection."""
        if self.kubernetes:
            raise JobValidationError(
                "Use kubernetes_conn_id for Airflow credentials "
                "and a job profile without kubernetes settings."
            )
        return self.to_submit_kwargs()

    def client(self) -> SparkOnK8S:
        return SparkOnK8S(
            k8s_client_manager=KubernetesClientManager(
                **{
                    "context": None,
                    "config_file": None,
                    "in_cluster": False,
                    "client_configuration": None,
                    **self.kubernetes,
                }
            )
        )

    def plan(self) -> ApplicationPlan:
        return self.client().plan_app(**self.to_submit_kwargs())

    def submit(self) -> str:
        return self.client().submit_app(**self.to_submit_kwargs())

@classmethod
def validate_profiles(cls, path: str | Path) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    """Validate the base and every named profile offline, reporting every failure."""
    _, document = cls._read_file(path)
    _object(document, None, "job")
    profiles = _object(document.get("profiles", {}), None, "profiles")
    results = []
    for profile in [None, *sorted(profiles)]:
        try:
            cls.from_file(path, profile=profile).plan()
        except (ValueError, TypeError, OSError) as error:
            results.append({"profile": profile, "valid": False, "error": str(error)})
        else:
            results.append({"profile": profile, "valid": True, "error": None})
    return results

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ApplicationPlan:
    """An offline preview; generated identifiers are illustrative, not reserved runs."""

    namespace: str
    app_id: str
    driver_pod: str
    resources: tuple[dict[str, Any], ...] = field(repr=False)
    capacity: dict[str, Any] | None = None

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        resources = copy.deepcopy(self.resources)
        for resource in resources:
            if resource["kind"] in {"Secret", "ConfigMap"}:
                for field in ("data", "stringData", "binaryData"):
                    if field in resource:
                        resource[field] = dict.fromkeys(resource[field], "<redacted>")
            if resource["kind"] == "Pod":
                containers = resource["spec"].get("containers", [])
                for index, container in enumerate(containers + resource["spec"].get("initContainers", [])):
                    for variable in container.get("env", []):
                        if "value" in variable:
                            variable["value"] = "<redacted>"
                    # Positional application arguments can contain credentials with no identifying key.
                    args = container.get("args", [])
                    if "command" in container:
                        container["command"] = ["<redacted command>" for _ in container["command"]]
                    if index == 0 and containers and args and args[0] == "driver":
                        position = 1
                        while position < len(args) and args[position].startswith("--"):
                            position += 2
                        if position < len(args):
                            args[position + 1 :] = ["<redacted argument>" for _ in args[position + 1 :]]
                    elif args:
                        container["args"] = ["<redacted argument>" for _ in args]
        return {
            "schema_version": 1,
            "preview": True,
            "namespace": self.namespace,
            "app_id": self.app_id,
            "driver_pod": self.driver_pod,
            "resources": [redact(resource) for resource in resources],
            "capacity": copy.deepcopy(self.capacity),
        }

def redact(value: Any, *, key: str = "") -> Any:
    """Return a display-only copy. Secret payloads and embedded file contents stay private."""
    if _SENSITIVE.search(key) and not key.endswith(("KeyRef", "secretRef")):
        return "<redacted>"
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return {name: redact(item, key=name) for name, item in value.items()}
    if isinstance(value, list):
        return [redact(item) for item in value]
    if isinstance(value, str):
        if "=" in value and (
            value.startswith("spark.kubernetes.driverEnv.") or _SENSITIVE.search(value.partition("=")[0])
        ):
            return value.partition("=")[0] + "=<redacted>"
        value = re.sub(
            r"([?;&](?:password|passwd|secret|token|credential|access[._-]?key|private[._-]?key)=)[^&#;\s]*",
            r"\1<redacted>",
            value,
            flags=re.I,
        )
        return re.sub(r"([a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*://)[^/@\s]+:[^/@\s]+@", r"\1<redacted>@", value, flags=re.I)
    return value
