def read_locations(query_file):
    """Read optional source coordinates; legacy arrays remain supported."""
    location_file = Path(query_file).with_name("locations.json")

def read_sql_file(file_path):
    """Read the JSON array of SQL statements prepared by the SQL submission helpers."""
    with open(file_path, encoding="utf-8") as f:
        commands = json.load(f)
    if not isinstance(commands, list) or not all(isinstance(command, str) for command in commands):
        raise ValueError("Expected a JSON array of SQL strings")
    return commands

def validate_locations(locations):
    """Reject malformed optional metadata before any SQL executes."""
    if locations is None:
        return None
    if (
        not isinstance(locations, dict)
        or type(locations.get("schema_version")) is not int
        or locations["schema_version"] != 1
    ):
        raise ValueError("Expected version 1 SQL source locations")
    source = locations.get("source", "<inline>")
    entries = locations.get("statements", [])
    if not isinstance(source, str) or not isinstance(entries, list):
        raise ValueError("Invalid SQL source locations")
    for entry in entries:
        if not isinstance(entry, dict) or (
            entry.get("line") is not None and (type(entry["line"]) is not int or entry["line"] < 1)
        ):
            raise ValueError("Invalid SQL source line")
    source = re.sub(r"[\x00-\x1f\x7f]", "_", source.replace("\\", "/").rsplit("/", 1)[-1])[:255] or "<inline>"
    return {**locations, "source": source}

class SparkAppManager(LoggingMixin):
    """Manage Spark apps on Kubernetes.

    Examples:
        >>> from spark_on_k8s.utils.app_manager import SparkAppManager
        >>> app_manager = SparkAppManager()
        >>> app_manager.stream_logs(
        ...     namespace="spark",
        ...     pod_name="20240114225118-driver",
        ...     should_print=True,
        ... )

    Args:
        k8s_client_manager (KubernetesClientManager, optional): Kubernetes client manager. Defaults to None.
        logger_name (str, optional): logger name. Defaults to "SparkAppManager".
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        *,
        k8s_client_manager: KubernetesClientManager | None = None,
        logger_name: str | None = None,
    ):
        super().__init__(logger_name=logger_name or "SparkAppManager")
        self.k8s_client_manager = k8s_client_manager or KubernetesClientManager()

    @staticmethod
    def _get_pod_name(*, app_id: str) -> str:
        if len(app_id) > 56:
            WarningCache.warn(
                message="The used app name or app id suffix is too long,"
                " pod name will be truncated and may not be unique",
                category=LongAppNameWarning,
                stacklevel=2,
                warning_id=app_id,
            )
        return f"{app_id[:56]}-driver"

    def app_status(
        self,
        *,
        namespace: str,
        pod_name: str | None = None,
        app_id: str | None = None,
        client: k8s.CoreV1Api | None = None,
        request_timeout: float | None = None,
    ) -> SparkAppStatus:
        """Get app status.

        Args:
            namespace (str): Namespace.
            pod_name (str): Pod name. Defaults to None.
            app_id (str): App ID. Defaults to None.
            client (k8s.CoreV1Api, optional): Kubernetes client. Defaults to None.

        Returns:
            SparkAppStatus: App status.

        Raises:
            ValueError: If neither pod_name nor app_id is provided.
            ApiException: If no matching pod exists (404), or the Kubernetes request fails.
        """

        def _app_status(_client: k8s.CoreV1Api) -> SparkAppStatus:
            if pod_name is None and app_id is None:
                raise ValueError("Either pod_name or app_id must be specified")
            if pod_name is not None:
                _pod = _client.read_namespaced_pod(
                    namespace=namespace,
                    name=pod_name,
                    **({"_request_timeout": request_timeout} if request_timeout is not None else {}),
                )
            else:
                pods = _client.list_namespaced_pod(
                    namespace=namespace,
                    label_selector=f"spark-app-id={app_id}",
                    **({"_request_timeout": request_timeout} if request_timeout is not None else {}),
                ).items
                if not pods:
                    raise ApiException(status=404, reason=f"No pods found for app {app_id}")
                _pod = pods[0]
            return get_app_status(_pod)

        if client is None:
            with self.k8s_client_manager.client() as client:
                api = k8s.CoreV1Api(client)
                return _app_status(api)
        return _app_status(client)

    def wait_for_app(
        self,
        *,
        namespace: str,
        pod_name: str | None = None,
        app_id: str | None = None,
        poll_interval: float = 10,
        should_print: bool = False,
        startup_timeout: float = 0,
        timeout: float | None = None,
    ):
        """Wait for a Spark app to finish.

        Args:
            namespace (str): Namespace.
            pod_name (str): Pod name.
            app_id (str): App ID.
            poll_interval (float, optional): Poll interval in seconds. Defaults to 10.
            startup_timeout (float, optional): Timeout in seconds to wait for the app to start.
                Defaults to 0 (no timeout).
            timeout (float, optional): Overall observation deadline in seconds, including running jobs.
                None disables the deadline. Expiration never stops or deletes the application.
            should_print (bool, optional): Whether to print logs instead of logging them.
        """
        deadline = WaitDeadline(timeout)
        start_time = time.time()
        termination_statuses = {SparkAppStatus.Succeeded, SparkAppStatus.Failed, SparkAppStatus.Unknown}
        with self.k8s_client_manager.client() as client:
            api = k8s.CoreV1Api(client)
            while True:
                try:
                    status = self.app_status(
                        namespace=namespace,
                        pod_name=pod_name,
                        app_id=app_id,
                        client=api,
                        **({"request_timeout": deadline.remaining()} if timeout is not None else {}),
                    )
                    deadline.remaining()
                    if status in termination_statuses:
                        break
                    if status == SparkAppStatus.Pending:
                        if startup_timeout and start_time + startup_timeout < time.time():
                            raise TimeoutError("App startup timeout")

                except ApiException as e:
                    if e.status == 404:
                        self.log(
                            msg=f"Pod {pod_name} was deleted", level=logging.INFO, should_print=should_print
                        )
                        return
                    raise
                self.log(
                    msg=f"Pod {pod_name} status is {status}, sleep {poll_interval}s",
                    level=logging.INFO,
                    should_print=should_print,
                )
                deadline.sleep(poll_interval)
            self.log(
                msg=f"Pod {pod_name} finished with status {status.value}",
                level=logging.INFO,
                should_print=should_print,
            )

    def stream_logs(
        self,
        *,
        namespace: str,
        pod_name: str | None = None,
        app_id: str | None = None,
        startup_timeout: float = 0,
        timeout: float | None = None,
        should_print: bool = False,
    ):
        """Stream logs from a Spark app.

        Args:
            namespace (str): Namespace.
            pod_name (str): Pod name.
            app_id (str): App ID.
            startup_timeout (float, optional): Timeout in seconds to wait for the app to start.
                Defaults to 0 (no timeout).
            timeout (float, optional): Overall observation deadline in seconds, including running jobs.
                None disables the deadline. Expiration never stops or deletes the application.
            should_print (bool, optional): Whether to print logs instead of logging them.
        """
        deadline = WaitDeadline(timeout)
        start_time = time.time()
        if pod_name is None and app_id is None:
            raise ValueError("Either pod_name or app_id must be specified")
        if pod_name is None:
            with self.k8s_client_manager.client() as client:
                api = k8s.CoreV1Api(client)
                pods = api.list_namespaced_pod(
                    namespace=namespace,
                    label_selector=f"spark-app-id={app_id}",
                    **deadline.request_options(),
                ).items
                if len(pods) == 0:
                    raise ValueError(f"No pods found for app {app_id}")
                pod_name = pods[0].metadata.name
        with self.k8s_client_manager.client() as client:
            api = k8s.CoreV1Api(client)
            while True:
                pod = api.read_namespaced_pod(
                    namespace=namespace,
                    name=pod_name,
                    **deadline.request_options(),
                )
                if pod.status.phase != "Pending":
                    break
                if startup_timeout and start_time + startup_timeout < time.time():
                    raise TimeoutError("App startup timeout")
                deadline.sleep(5)
            watcher = watch.Watch()
            expired = Event()
            timer = None
            if timeout is not None:

                def expire():
                    expired.set()
                    watcher.stop()

                timer = Timer(deadline.remaining(), expire)
                timer.daemon = True
                timer.start()
            retries = 3
            received = False
            stream = None
            try:
                while True:
                    try:
                        stream = watcher.stream(
                            api.read_namespaced_pod_log,
                            namespace=namespace,
                            name=pod_name,
                            container=pod.spec.containers[0].name,
                            **deadline.request_options(),
                        )
                        for line in stream:
                            deadline.remaining()
                            self.log(msg=line, level=logging.INFO, should_print=should_print)
                            received = True
                        deadline.remaining()
                        break
                    except ApiException as error:
                        if received or retries == 0:
                            raise
                        self.log(
                            msg=f"Failed to connect to the pod log stream: {error}. Retrying in 5s",
                            level=logging.WARNING,
                            should_print=should_print,
                        )
                        retries -= 1
                        deadline.sleep(5)
                    finally:
                        close = getattr(stream, "close", None)
                        if close is not None:
                            close()
            finally:
                if timer is not None:
                    timer.cancel()
                    timer.join()
                watcher.stop()
                if expired.is_set():
                    raise TimeoutError("Application wait timeout exceeded")

    def list_apps(self, namespace: str) -> list[str]:
        """List apps.

        Args:
            namespace (str): Namespace.

        Returns:
            list[str]: Spark apps in the namespace.
        """
        with self.k8s_client_manager.client() as client:
            api = k8s.CoreV1Api(client)
            return [
                pod.metadata.labels["spark-app-id"]
                for pod in api.list_namespaced_pod(
                    namespace=namespace,
                    label_selector="spark-role=driver",
                ).items
            ]

    def kill_app(
        self,
        namespace: str,
        pod_name: str | None = None,
        app_id: str | None = None,
        should_print: bool = False,
    ):
        """Kill an app.

        Args:
            namespace (str): Namespace.
            pod_name (str): Pod name.
            app_id (str): App ID.
            should_print (bool, optional): Whether to print logs instead of logging them.
        """
        if pod_name is None and app_id is None:
            raise ValueError("Either pod_name or app_id must be specified")
        with self.k8s_client_manager.client() as client:
            api = k8s.CoreV1Api(client)
            if pod_name is None:
                pods = api.list_namespaced_pod(
                    namespace=namespace,
                    label_selector=f"spark-app-id={app_id}",
                ).items
                if len(pods) == 0:
                    raise ValueError(f"No pods found for app {app_id}")
                pod = pods[0]
            else:
                pod = api.read_namespaced_pod(
                    namespace=namespace,
                    name=pod_name,
                )
            container_name = pod.spec.containers[0].name
            if pod.status.phase != "Running":
                self.log(
                    f"App is not running, it is {get_app_status(pod).value}",
                    level=logging.INFO,
                    should_print=should_print,
                )
                return
            stream(
                api.connect_get_namespaced_pod_exec,
                pod.metadata.name,
                namespace,
                command=["/bin/sh", "-c", "kill 1"],
                container=container_name,
                stderr=True,
                stdin=False,
                stdout=True,
                tty=False,
                _preload_content=False,
            )

    def cancel_run(self, run, *, force: bool = False) -> None:
        """Cancel a UID-bearing run without deleting a replacement or another application."""
        if not isinstance(run.driver_uid, str) or not run.driver_uid:
            raise ValueError("Cancellation requires a receipt with a driver UID")
        with self.k8s_client_manager.client() as client:
            api = k8s.CoreV1Api(client)
            pod = api.read_namespaced_pod(name=run.driver_pod, namespace=run.namespace)
            labels = pod.metadata.labels or {}
            if (
                pod.metadata.uid != run.driver_uid
                or labels.get("spark-app-id") != run.app_id
                or labels.get("spark-role") != "driver"
            ):
                raise ValueError("The recorded driver identity does not match the current pod")
            api.delete_namespaced_pod(
                name=run.driver_pod,
                namespace=run.namespace,
                body=k8s.V1DeleteOptions(
                    grace_period_seconds=0 if force else None,
                    propagation_policy="Foreground",
                    preconditions=k8s.V1Preconditions(uid=run.driver_uid),
                ),
            )

    def delete_app(
        self, namespace: str, pod_name: str | None = None, app_id: str | None = None, force: bool = False
    ):
        """Delete an app.

        Args:
            namespace (str): Namespace.
            pod_name (str): Pod name.
            app_id (str): App ID.
            force (bool, optional): Whether to force delete the app. Defaults to False.
        """
        if pod_name is None and app_id is None:
            raise ValueError("Either pod_name or app_id must be specified")
        with self.k8s_client_manager.client() as client:
            api = k8s.CoreV1Api(client)
            if app_id:
                # we don't use `delete_collection_namespaced_pod` to know if the app exists or not
                pods = api.list_namespaced_pod(
                    namespace=namespace,
                    label_selector=f"spark-app-id={app_id},spark-role=driver",
                ).items
                if len(pods) == 0:
                    raise ValueError(f"No pods found for app {app_id}")
                if len(pods) > 1:
                    raise ValueError(f"Multiple driver pods found for app {app_id}; use a run receipt")
                pod_name = pods[0].metadata.name
            api.delete_namespaced_pod(
                name=pod_name,
                namespace=namespace,
                body=k8s.V1DeleteOptions(
                    grace_period_seconds=0 if force else None,
                    propagation_policy="Foreground",
                ),
            )

    @staticmethod
    def create_spark_pod_spec(
        *,
        app_name: str,
        app_id: str,
        image: str,
        namespace: str = "default",
        service_account: str = "spark",
        container_name: str = "driver",
        env_variables: dict[str, str] | None = None,
        pod_resources: dict[str, dict[str, str]] | None = None,
        args: list[str] | None = None,
        image_pull_policy: Literal["Always", "Never", "IfNotPresent"] = "IfNotPresent",
        extra_labels: dict[str, str] | None = None,
        annotations: dict[str, str] | None = None,
        env_from_secrets: list[str] | None = None,
        volumes: list[k8s.V1Volume] | None = None,
        volume_mounts: list[k8s.V1VolumeMount] | None = None,
        node_selector: dict[str, str] | None = None,
        tolerations: list[k8s.V1Toleration] | None = None,
        init_containers: list[k8s.V1Container] | None = None,
        host_aliases: list[k8s.V1HostAlias] | None = None,
    ) -> k8s.V1PodTemplateSpec:
        """Create a pod spec for a Spark application

        Args:
            app_name: Name of the Spark application
            app_id: ID of the Spark application
            image: Docker image to use for the Spark driver and executors
            namespace: Kubernetes namespace to use, defaults to "default"
            service_account: Kubernetes service account to use for the Spark driver, defaults to "spark"
            container_name: Name of the container, defaults to "driver"
            env_variables: Dictionary of environment variables to pass to the container
            pod_resources: Dictionary of resources to request for the container
            args: List of arguments to pass to the container
            image_pull_policy: Image pull policy for the driver and executors, defaults to "IfNotPresent"
            extra_labels: Dictionary of extra labels to add to the pod template
            annotations: Dictionary of annotations to add to the pod template
            env_from_secrets: List of secrets to load environment variables from
            volumes: List of volumes to mount in the pod
            volume_mounts: List of volume mounts to mount in the container
            node_selector: Node selector to use for the pod
            tolerations: List of tolerations to use for the pod
            init_containers: List of init containers to run before the main container
            host_aliases: List of host aliases to add to the pod

        Returns:
            Pod template spec for the Spark application
        """
        pod_metadata = k8s.V1ObjectMeta(
            name=SparkAppManager._get_pod_name(app_id=app_id),
            namespace=namespace,
            labels=SparkAppManager.spark_app_labels(
                app_name=app_name,
                app_id=app_id,
                extra_labels=extra_labels,
            ),
            annotations=annotations,
        )
        pod_spec = k8s.V1PodSpec(
            service_account_name=service_account,
            restart_policy="Never",
            containers=[
                SparkAppManager.create_driver_container(
                    image=image,
                    container_name=container_name,
                    env_variables=env_variables,
                    pod_resources=pod_resources,
                    args=args,
                    image_pull_policy=image_pull_policy,
                    env_from_secrets=env_from_secrets,
                    volume_mounts=volume_mounts,
                )
            ],
            volumes=volumes,
            node_selector=node_selector,
            tolerations=tolerations,
            init_containers=init_containers,
            host_aliases=host_aliases,
        )
        template = k8s.V1PodTemplateSpec(
            metadata=pod_metadata,
            spec=pod_spec,
        )
        return template

    @staticmethod
    def create_driver_container(
        *,
        image: str,
        container_name: str = "driver",
        env_variables: dict[str, str] | None = None,
        pod_resources: dict[str, dict[str, str]] | None = None,
        args: list[str] | None = None,
        image_pull_policy: Literal["Always", "Never", "IfNotPresent"] = "IfNotPresent",
        env_from_secrets: list[str] | None = None,
        volume_mounts: list[k8s.V1VolumeMount] | None = None,
    ) -> k8s.V1Container:
        """Create a container spec for the Spark driver

        Args:
            image: Docker image to use for the Spark driver and executors
            container_name: Name of the container, defaults to "driver"
            env_variables: Dictionary of environment variables to pass to the container
            pod_resources: Dictionary of resources to request for the container
            args: List of arguments to pass to the container
            image_pull_policy: Image pull policy for the driver and executors, defaults to "IfNotPresent"
            env_from_secrets: List of secrets to load environment variables from
            volume_mounts: List of volume mounts to mount in the container

        Returns:
            Container spec for the Spark driver
        """
        return k8s.V1Container(
            name=container_name,
            image=image,
            image_pull_policy=image_pull_policy,
            env=[k8s.V1EnvVar(name=key, value=value) for key, value in (env_variables or {}).items()]
            + [
                k8s.V1EnvVar(
                    name="SPARK_DRIVER_BIND_ADDRESS",
                    value_from=k8s.V1EnvVarSource(
                        field_ref=k8s.V1ObjectFieldSelector(
                            field_path="status.podIP",
                        )
                    ),
                ),
            ],
            resources=k8s.V1ResourceRequirements(
                **(pod_resources or {}),
            ),
            args=args or [],
            ports=[
                k8s.V1ContainerPort(
                    container_port=7077,
                    name="driver-port",
                ),
                k8s.V1ContainerPort(
                    container_port=4040,
                    name="ui-port",
                ),
            ],
            env_from=[
                k8s.V1EnvFromSource(
                    secret_ref=k8s.V1SecretEnvSource(
                        name=secret_name,
                    ),
                )
                for secret_name in (env_from_secrets or [])
            ],
            volume_mounts=volume_mounts,
        )

    @staticmethod
    def spark_app_labels(
        *,
        app_name: str,
        app_id: str,
        extra_labels: dict[str, str] | None = None,
    ) -> dict[str, str]:
        """Create labels for a Spark application

        Args:
            app_name: Name of the Spark application
            app_id: ID of the Spark application
            extra_labels: Dictionary of extra labels to add to the labels

        Returns:
            Dictionary of labels for the Spark application resources
        """
        return {
            "spark-app-name": app_name,
            "spark-app-id": app_id,
            "spark-role": "driver",
            **(extra_labels or {}),
        }

    @staticmethod
    def create_headless_service_object(
        *,
        app_name: str,
        app_id: str,
        namespace: str = "default",
        pod_owner_uid: str | None = None,
        extra_labels: dict[str, str] | None = None,
    ) -> k8s.V1Service:
        """Create a headless service for a Spark application

        Args:
            app_name: Name of the Spark application
            app_id: ID of the Spark application
            namespace: Kubernetes namespace to use, defaults to "default"

def app_status(
    self,
    *,
    namespace: str,
    pod_name: str | None = None,
    app_id: str | None = None,
    client: k8s.CoreV1Api | None = None,
    request_timeout: float | None = None,
) -> SparkAppStatus:
    """Get app status.

    Args:
        namespace (str): Namespace.
        pod_name (str): Pod name. Defaults to None.
        app_id (str): App ID. Defaults to None.
        client (k8s.CoreV1Api, optional): Kubernetes client. Defaults to None.

    Returns:
        SparkAppStatus: App status.

    Raises:
        ValueError: If neither pod_name nor app_id is provided.
        ApiException: If no matching pod exists (404), or the Kubernetes request fails.
    """

    def _app_status(_client: k8s.CoreV1Api) -> SparkAppStatus:
        if pod_name is None and app_id is None:
            raise ValueError("Either pod_name or app_id must be specified")
        if pod_name is not None:
            _pod = _client.read_namespaced_pod(
                namespace=namespace,
                name=pod_name,
                **({"_request_timeout": request_timeout} if request_timeout is not None else {}),
            )
        else:
            pods = _client.list_namespaced_pod(
                namespace=namespace,
                label_selector=f"spark-app-id={app_id}",
                **({"_request_timeout": request_timeout} if request_timeout is not None else {}),
            ).items
            if not pods:
                raise ApiException(status=404, reason=f"No pods found for app {app_id}")
            _pod = pods[0]
        return get_app_status(_pod)

    if client is None:
        with self.k8s_client_manager.client() as client:
            api = k8s.CoreV1Api(client)
            return _app_status(api)
    return _app_status(client)

def cancel_run(self, run, *, force: bool = False) -> None:
    """Cancel a UID-bearing run without deleting a replacement or another application."""
    if not isinstance(run.driver_uid, str) or not run.driver_uid:
        raise ValueError("Cancellation requires a receipt with a driver UID")
    with self.k8s_client_manager.client() as client:
        api = k8s.CoreV1Api(client)
        pod = api.read_namespaced_pod(name=run.driver_pod, namespace=run.namespace)
        labels = pod.metadata.labels or {}
        if (
            pod.metadata.uid != run.driver_uid
            or labels.get("spark-app-id") != run.app_id
            or labels.get("spark-role") != "driver"
        ):
            raise ValueError("The recorded driver identity does not match the current pod")
        api.delete_namespaced_pod(
            name=run.driver_pod,
            namespace=run.namespace,
            body=k8s.V1DeleteOptions(
                grace_period_seconds=0 if force else None,
                propagation_policy="Foreground",
                preconditions=k8s.V1Preconditions(uid=run.driver_uid),
            ),
        )

@staticmethod
def create_driver_container(
    *,
    image: str,
    container_name: str = "driver",
    env_variables: dict[str, str] | None = None,
    pod_resources: dict[str, dict[str, str]] | None = None,
    args: list[str] | None = None,
    image_pull_policy: Literal["Always", "Never", "IfNotPresent"] = "IfNotPresent",
    env_from_secrets: list[str] | None = None,
    volume_mounts: list[k8s.V1VolumeMount] | None = None,
) -> k8s.V1Container:
    """Create a container spec for the Spark driver

    Args:
        image: Docker image to use for the Spark driver and executors
        container_name: Name of the container, defaults to "driver"
        env_variables: Dictionary of environment variables to pass to the container
        pod_resources: Dictionary of resources to request for the container
        args: List of arguments to pass to the container
        image_pull_policy: Image pull policy for the driver and executors, defaults to "IfNotPresent"
        env_from_secrets: List of secrets to load environment variables from
        volume_mounts: List of volume mounts to mount in the container

    Returns:
        Container spec for the Spark driver
    """
    return k8s.V1Container(
        name=container_name,
        image=image,
        image_pull_policy=image_pull_policy,
        env=[k8s.V1EnvVar(name=key, value=value) for key, value in (env_variables or {}).items()]
        + [
            k8s.V1EnvVar(
                name="SPARK_DRIVER_BIND_ADDRESS",
                value_from=k8s.V1EnvVarSource(
                    field_ref=k8s.V1ObjectFieldSelector(
                        field_path="status.podIP",
                    )
                ),
            ),
        ],
        resources=k8s.V1ResourceRequirements(
            **(pod_resources or {}),
        ),
        args=args or [],
        ports=[
            k8s.V1ContainerPort(
                container_port=7077,
                name="driver-port",
            ),
            k8s.V1ContainerPort(
                container_port=4040,
                name="ui-port",
            ),
        ],
        env_from=[
            k8s.V1EnvFromSource(
                secret_ref=k8s.V1SecretEnvSource(
                    name=secret_name,
                ),
            )
            for secret_name in (env_from_secrets or [])
        ],
        volume_mounts=volume_mounts,
    )

def delete_app(
    self, namespace: str, pod_name: str | None = None, app_id: str | None = None, force: bool = False
):
    """Delete an app.

    Args:
        namespace (str): Namespace.
        pod_name (str): Pod name.
        app_id (str): App ID.
        force (bool, optional): Whether to force delete the app. Defaults to False.
    """
    if pod_name is None and app_id is None:
        raise ValueError("Either pod_name or app_id must be specified")
    with self.k8s_client_manager.client() as client:
        api = k8s.CoreV1Api(client)
        if app_id:
            # we don't use `delete_collection_namespaced_pod` to know if the app exists or not
            pods = api.list_namespaced_pod(
                namespace=namespace,
                label_selector=f"spark-app-id={app_id},spark-role=driver",
            ).items
            if len(pods) == 0:
                raise ValueError(f"No pods found for app {app_id}")
            if len(pods) > 1:
                raise ValueError(f"Multiple driver pods found for app {app_id}; use a run receipt")
            pod_name = pods[0].metadata.name
        api.delete_namespaced_pod(
            name=pod_name,
            namespace=namespace,
            body=k8s.V1DeleteOptions(
                grace_period_seconds=0 if force else None,
                propagation_policy="Foreground",
            ),
        )

def stream_logs(
    self,
    *,
    namespace: str,
    pod_name: str | None = None,
    app_id: str | None = None,
    startup_timeout: float = 0,
    timeout: float | None = None,
    should_print: bool = False,
):
    """Stream logs from a Spark app.

    Args:
        namespace (str): Namespace.
        pod_name (str): Pod name.
        app_id (str): App ID.
        startup_timeout (float, optional): Timeout in seconds to wait for the app to start.
            Defaults to 0 (no timeout).
        timeout (float, optional): Overall observation deadline in seconds, including running jobs.
            None disables the deadline. Expiration never stops or deletes the application.
        should_print (bool, optional): Whether to print logs instead of logging them.
    """
    deadline = WaitDeadline(timeout)
    start_time = time.time()
    if pod_name is None and app_id is None:
        raise ValueError("Either pod_name or app_id must be specified")
    if pod_name is None:
        with self.k8s_client_manager.client() as client:
            api = k8s.CoreV1Api(client)
            pods = api.list_namespaced_pod(
                namespace=namespace,
                label_selector=f"spark-app-id={app_id}",
                **deadline.request_options(),
            ).items
            if len(pods) == 0:
                raise ValueError(f"No pods found for app {app_id}")
            pod_name = pods[0].metadata.name
    with self.k8s_client_manager.client() as client:
        api = k8s.CoreV1Api(client)
        while True:
            pod = api.read_namespaced_pod(
                namespace=namespace,
                name=pod_name,
                **deadline.request_options(),
            )
            if pod.status.phase != "Pending":
                break
            if startup_timeout and start_time + startup_timeout < time.time():
                raise TimeoutError("App startup timeout")
            deadline.sleep(5)
        watcher = watch.Watch()
        expired = Event()
        timer = None
        if timeout is not None:

            def expire():
                expired.set()
                watcher.stop()

            timer = Timer(deadline.remaining(), expire)
            timer.daemon = True
            timer.start()
        retries = 3
        received = False
        stream = None
        try:
            while True:
                try:
                    stream = watcher.stream(
                        api.read_namespaced_pod_log,
                        namespace=namespace,
                        name=pod_name,
                        container=pod.spec.containers[0].name,
                        **deadline.request_options(),
                    )
                    for line in stream:
                        deadline.remaining()
                        self.log(msg=line, level=logging.INFO, should_print=should_print)
                        received = True
                    deadline.remaining()
                    break
                except ApiException as error:
                    if received or retries == 0:
                        raise
                    self.log(
                        msg=f"Failed to connect to the pod log stream: {error}. Retrying in 5s",
                        level=logging.WARNING,
                        should_print=should_print,
                    )
                    retries -= 1
                    deadline.sleep(5)
                finally:
                    close = getattr(stream, "close", None)
                    if close is not None:
                        close()
        finally:
            if timer is not None:
                timer.cancel()
                timer.join()
            watcher.stop()
            if expired.is_set():
                raise TimeoutError("Application wait timeout exceeded")

def wait_for_app(
    self,
    *,
    namespace: str,
    pod_name: str | None = None,
    app_id: str | None = None,
    poll_interval: float = 10,
    should_print: bool = False,
    startup_timeout: float = 0,
    timeout: float | None = None,
):
    """Wait for a Spark app to finish.

    Args:
        namespace (str): Namespace.
        pod_name (str): Pod name.
        app_id (str): App ID.
        poll_interval (float, optional): Poll interval in seconds. Defaults to 10.
        startup_timeout (float, optional): Timeout in seconds to wait for the app to start.
            Defaults to 0 (no timeout).
        timeout (float, optional): Overall observation deadline in seconds, including running jobs.
            None disables the deadline. Expiration never stops or deletes the application.
        should_print (bool, optional): Whether to print logs instead of logging them.
    """
    deadline = WaitDeadline(timeout)
    start_time = time.time()
    termination_statuses = {SparkAppStatus.Succeeded, SparkAppStatus.Failed, SparkAppStatus.Unknown}
    with self.k8s_client_manager.client() as client:
        api = k8s.CoreV1Api(client)
        while True:
            try:
                status = self.app_status(
                    namespace=namespace,
                    pod_name=pod_name,
                    app_id=app_id,
                    client=api,
                    **({"request_timeout": deadline.remaining()} if timeout is not None else {}),
                )
                deadline.remaining()
                if status in termination_statuses:
                    break
                if status == SparkAppStatus.Pending:
                    if startup_timeout and start_time + startup_timeout < time.time():
                        raise TimeoutError("App startup timeout")

            except ApiException as e:
                if e.status == 404:
                    self.log(
                        msg=f"Pod {pod_name} was deleted", level=logging.INFO, should_print=should_print
                    )
                    return
                raise
            self.log(
                msg=f"Pod {pod_name} status is {status}, sleep {poll_interval}s",
                level=logging.INFO,
                should_print=should_print,
            )
            deadline.sleep(poll_interval)
        self.log(
            msg=f"Pod {pod_name} finished with status {status.value}",
            level=logging.INFO,
            should_print=should_print,
        )

class AsyncSparkAppManager(LoggingMixin):
    """Manage Spark apps on Kubernetes asynchronously.

    Args:
        k8s_client_manager (KubernetesClientManager, optional): Kubernetes client manager. Defaults to None.
        logger_name (str, optional): logger name. Defaults to "SparkAppManager".
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        *,
        k8s_client_manager: KubernetesAsyncClientManager | None = None,
        logger_name: str | None = None,
    ):
        super().__init__(logger_name=logger_name or "SparkAppManager")
        self.k8s_client_manager = k8s_client_manager or KubernetesAsyncClientManager()

    async def app_status(
        self,
        *,
        namespace: str,
        pod_name: str | None = None,
        app_id: str | None = None,
        client: k8s_async.CoreV1Api | None = None,
    ) -> SparkAppStatus:
        """Get app status asynchronously.

        Args:
            namespace (str): Namespace.
            pod_name (str): Pod name. Defaults to None.
            app_id (str): App ID. Defaults to None.
            client (k8s.CoreV1Api, optional): Kubernetes client. Defaults to None.

        Returns:
            SparkAppStatus: App status.

        Raises:
            ValueError: If neither pod_name nor app_id is provided.
            ApiException: If no matching pod exists (404), or the Kubernetes request fails.
        """

        async def _app_status(_client: k8s_async.CoreV1Api) -> SparkAppStatus:
            if pod_name is None and app_id is None:
                raise ValueError("Either pod_name or app_id must be specified")
            if pod_name is not None:
                _pod = await _client.read_namespaced_pod(
                    namespace=namespace,
                    name=pod_name,
                )
            else:
                pods = (
                    await _client.list_namespaced_pod(
                        namespace=namespace,
                        label_selector=f"spark-app-id={app_id}",
                    )
                ).items
                if not pods:
                    raise ApiException(status=404, reason=f"No pods found for app {app_id}")
                _pod = pods[0]
            return get_app_status(_pod)

        if client is None:
            async with self.k8s_client_manager.client() as client:
                api = k8s_async.CoreV1Api(client)
                return await _app_status(api)
        return await _app_status(client)

    async def wait_for_app(
        self,
        *,
        namespace: str,
        pod_name: str | None = None,
        app_id: str | None = None,
        poll_interval: float = 10,
        should_print: bool = False,
        startup_deadline: float | None = None,
    ):
        """Wait for a Spark app to finish asynchronously.

        Args:
            namespace (str): Namespace.
            pod_name (str): Pod name.
            app_id (str): App ID.
            poll_interval (float, optional): Poll interval in seconds. Defaults to 10.
            should_print (bool, optional): Whether to print logs instead of logging them.
            startup_deadline (float, optional): Absolute Unix timestamp after which a Pending
                driver times out. Defaults to None (no startup timeout). Running applications
                are not limited by this deadline.
        """
        termination_statuses = {SparkAppStatus.Succeeded, SparkAppStatus.Failed, SparkAppStatus.Unknown}
        async with self.k8s_client_manager.client() as client:
            api = k8s_async.CoreV1Api(client)
            while True:
                sleep_interval = poll_interval
                try:
                    status = await self.app_status(
                        namespace=namespace, pod_name=pod_name, app_id=app_id, client=api
                    )
                    if status in termination_statuses:
                        break
                    if status == SparkAppStatus.Pending and startup_deadline is not None:
                        remaining = startup_deadline - time.time()
                        if remaining <= 0:
                            raise SparkAppStartupTimeoutError("App startup timeout")
                        sleep_interval = min(poll_interval, remaining)
                except ApiException as e:
                    if e.status == 404:
                        self.log(
                            msg=f"Pod {pod_name} was deleted", level=logging.INFO, should_print=should_print
                        )
                        return
                    raise
                self.log(
                    msg=f"Pod {pod_name} status is {status}, sleep {sleep_interval}s",
                    level=logging.INFO,
                    should_print=should_print,
                )
                await asyncio.sleep(sleep_interval)
            self.log(
                msg=f"Pod {pod_name} finished with status {status.value}",
                level=logging.INFO,
                should_print=should_print,
            )

    async def logs_streamer(
        self,
        *,
        namespace: str,
        pod_name: str | None = None,
        app_id: str | None = None,
        tail_lines: int = -1,
    ):
        """Stream logs from a Spark app asynchronously.

        Args:
            namespace (str): Namespace.
            pod_name (str): Pod name.
            app_id (str): App ID.
            tail_lines (int, optional): Number of lines to tail. Defaults to -1.
        """
        if pod_name is None and app_id is None:
            raise ValueError("Either pod_name or app_id must be specified")
        if pod_name is None:
            async with self.k8s_client_manager.client() as client:
                api = k8s_async.CoreV1Api(client)
                pods = (
                    await api.list_namespaced_pod(
                        namespace=namespace,
                        label_selector=f"spark-app-id={app_id}",
                    )
                ).items
                if len(pods) == 0:
                    raise ValueError(f"No pods found for app {app_id}")
                pod_name = pods[0].metadata.name

        async with self.k8s_client_manager.client() as client:
            api = k8s_async.CoreV1Api(client)
            while True:
                pod = await api.read_namespaced_pod(
                    namespace=namespace,
                    name=pod_name,
                )
                if pod.status.phase != "Pending":
                    break
                await asyncio.sleep(5)

            async with watch.Watch() as watcher:
                log_streamer = watcher.stream(
                    api.read_namespaced_pod_log,
                    namespace=namespace,
                    name=pod_name,
                    container=pod.spec.containers[0].name,
                    tail_lines=tail_lines if tail_lines > 0 else None,
                    follow=True,
                )
                async for line in log_streamer:
                    yield line

    async def kill_app(
        self,
        namespace: str,
        pod_name: str | None = None,
        app_id: str | None = None,
    ):
        """Kill an app asynchronously.

        Args:
            namespace (str): Namespace.
            pod_name (str): Pod name.
            app_id (str): App ID.
        """
        if pod_name is None and app_id is None:
            raise ValueError("Either pod_name or app_id must be specified")
        async with self.k8s_client_manager.client() as client:
            api = k8s_async.CoreV1Api(client)
            if pod_name is None:
                pods = (
                    await api.list_namespaced_pod(
                        namespace=namespace,
                        label_selector=f"spark-app-id={app_id}",
                    )
                ).items
                if len(pods) == 0:
                    raise ValueError(f"No pods found for app {app_id}")
                pod = pods[0]
            else:
                pod = await api.read_namespaced_pod(
                    namespace=namespace,
                    name=pod_name,
                )
            container_name = pod.spec.containers[0].name
            if pod.status.phase != "Running":
                raise ValueError(f"Pod {pod.metadata.name} is not running")
            async with WsApiClient() as websocket_client:
                v1_ws = k8s_async.CoreV1Api(api_client=websocket_client)
                await stream(
                    v1_ws.connect_get_namespaced_pod_exec,
                    pod.metadata.name,
                    namespace,
                    command=["/bin/sh", "-c", "kill 1"],
                    container=container_name,
                    stderr=True,
                    stdin=False,
                    stdout=True,
                    tty=False,
                    _preload_content=True,
                )

    async def delete_app(
        self, namespace: str, pod_name: str | None = None, app_id: str | None = None, force: bool = False
    ):
        """Delete an app asynchronously.

        Args:
            namespace (str): Namespace.
            pod_name (str): Pod name.
            app_id (str): App ID.
            force (bool, optional): Whether to force delete the app. Defaults to False.
        """
        if pod_name is None and app_id is None:
            raise ValueError("Either pod_name or app_id must be specified")
        async with self.k8s_client_manager.client() as client:
            api = k8s_async.CoreV1Api(client)
            if app_id:
                # we don't use `delete_collection_namespaced_pod` to know if the app exists or not
                pods = (
                    await api.list_namespaced_pod(
                        namespace=namespace,
                        label_selector=f"spark-app-id={app_id},spark-role=driver",
                    )
                ).items
                if len(pods) == 0:
                    raise ValueError(f"No pods found for app {app_id}")
                if len(pods) > 1:
                    raise ValueError(f"Multiple driver pods found for app {app_id}; use a run receipt")
                pod_name = pods[0].metadata.name
            await api.delete_namespaced_pod(
                name=pod_name,
                namespace=namespace,
                body=k8s_async.V1DeleteOptions(
                    grace_period_seconds=0 if force else None,
                    propagation_policy="Foreground",
                ),
            )

    namespace: str,
    pod_name: str | None = None,
    app_id: str | None = None,
    tail_lines: int = -1,
):
    """Stream logs from a Spark app asynchronously.

    Args:
        namespace (str): Namespace.
        pod_name (str): Pod name.
        app_id (str): App ID.
        tail_lines (int, optional): Number of lines to tail. Defaults to -1.
    """
    if pod_name is None and app_id is None:
        raise ValueError("Either pod_name or app_id must be specified")
    if pod_name is None:
        async with self.k8s_client_manager.client() as client:
            api = k8s_async.CoreV1Api(client)
            pods = (
                await api.list_namespaced_pod(
                    namespace=namespace,
                    label_selector=f"spark-app-id={app_id}",
                )
            ).items
            if len(pods) == 0:
                raise ValueError(f"No pods found for app {app_id}")
            pod_name = pods[0].metadata.name

    async with self.k8s_client_manager.client() as client:
        api = k8s_async.CoreV1Api(client)
        while True:
            pod = await api.read_namespaced_pod(
                namespace=namespace,
                name=pod_name,
            )
            if pod.status.phase != "Pending":
                break
            await asyncio.sleep(5)

        async with watch.Watch() as watcher:
            log_streamer = watcher.stream(
                api.read_namespaced_pod_log,
                namespace=namespace,
                name=pod_name,
                container=pod.spec.containers[0].name,
                tail_lines=tail_lines if tail_lines > 0 else None,
                follow=True,
            )
            async for line in log_streamer:
                yield line

async def wait_for_app(
    self,
    *,
    namespace: str,
    pod_name: str | None = None,
    app_id: str | None = None,
    poll_interval: float = 10,
    should_print: bool = False,
    startup_deadline: float | None = None,
):
    """Wait for a Spark app to finish asynchronously.

    Args:
        namespace (str): Namespace.
        pod_name (str): Pod name.
        app_id (str): App ID.
        poll_interval (float, optional): Poll interval in seconds. Defaults to 10.
        should_print (bool, optional): Whether to print logs instead of logging them.
        startup_deadline (float, optional): Absolute Unix timestamp after which a Pending
            driver times out. Defaults to None (no startup timeout). Running applications
            are not limited by this deadline.
    """
    termination_statuses = {SparkAppStatus.Succeeded, SparkAppStatus.Failed, SparkAppStatus.Unknown}
    async with self.k8s_client_manager.client() as client:
        api = k8s_async.CoreV1Api(client)
        while True:
            sleep_interval = poll_interval
            try:
                status = await self.app_status(
                    namespace=namespace, pod_name=pod_name, app_id=app_id, client=api
                )
                if status in termination_statuses:
                    break
                if status == SparkAppStatus.Pending and startup_deadline is not None:
                    remaining = startup_deadline - time.time()
                    if remaining <= 0:
                        raise SparkAppStartupTimeoutError("App startup timeout")
                    sleep_interval = min(poll_interval, remaining)
            except ApiException as e:
                if e.status == 404:
                    self.log(
                        msg=f"Pod {pod_name} was deleted", level=logging.INFO, should_print=should_print
                    )
                    return
                raise
            self.log(
                msg=f"Pod {pod_name} status is {status}, sleep {sleep_interval}s",
                level=logging.INFO,
                should_print=should_print,
            )
            await asyncio.sleep(sleep_interval)
        self.log(
            msg=f"Pod {pod_name} finished with status {status.value}",
            level=logging.INFO,
            should_print=should_print,
        )

class AirflowTaskContext(BaseModel):
    """Non-secret task identity recorded on an operator-created driver pod."""

    dag_id: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=250)
    run_id: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=250)
    task_id: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=250)
    map_index: int = Field(default=-1, ge=-1, strict=True)
    try_number: int = Field(ge=1, strict=True)
    region_id: UUID | None = None
    region_index: int | None = Field(default=None, ge=-1, strict=True)

    def owns_same_task(self, other: AirflowTaskContext) -> bool:
        # An Airflow retry may legitimately adopt its previous attempt's running pod.
        # Region identity disambiguates dynamic mappings that share a public map index.
        return (
            self.dag_id == other.dag_id
            and self.run_id == other.run_id
            and self.task_id == other.task_id
            and self.map_index == other.map_index
            and (self.region_id or UUID(int=0)) == (other.region_id or UUID(int=0))
            and (self.region_index if self.region_index is not None else self.map_index)
            == (other.region_index if other.region_index is not None else other.map_index)
        )

def load_driver_pod_template(template: str | Path | Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Load a local Pod YAML file, YAML text, or mapping without changing the input."""
    from collections.abc import Mapping

    if isinstance(template, Mapping):
        pod = deepcopy(dict(template))
    else:
        if isinstance(template, Path):
            try:
                content = template.expanduser().read_text(encoding="utf-8")
            except OSError as exc:
                raise ValueError(f"Cannot read driver pod template file: {template}") from exc
        elif isinstance(template, str):
            try:
                path = Path(template).expanduser()
                is_file = "\n" not in template and path.is_file()
            except OSError:
                is_file = False
            if is_file:
                try:
                    content = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
                except OSError as exc:
                    raise ValueError(f"Cannot read driver pod template file: {template}") from exc
            else:
                content = template
        else:
            raise ValueError("Driver pod template must be YAML text, a local path, or a mapping")
        try:
            pod = yaml.load(content, Loader=_UniqueKeyLoader)
        except yaml.YAMLError as exc:
            raise ValueError("Driver pod template contains invalid YAML") from exc
    _validate_template(pod)
    return pod

def merge_driver_pod_template(
    generated: k8s.V1PodTemplateSpec,
    template: dict[str, Any],
    driver_container_name: str | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Overlay a generated driver on a validated Pod template, preserving other fields.

    The returned API dictionary preserves Kubernetes fields not modeled by this client
    version. Validation here covers template shape and merge ambiguity; the API server
    remains responsible for Kubernetes schema, admission, and cluster policy checks.
    """
    _validate_template(template)
    pod = deepcopy(template)
    with k8s.ApiClient() as api_client:
        managed = api_client.sanitize_for_serialization(generated)
    containers = pod["spec"]["containers"]
    names = [container["name"] for container in containers]
    selected = driver_container_name
    if selected is None:
        selected = "driver" if "driver" in names else names[0] if len(names) == 1 else None
    if selected not in names:
        raise ValueError(
            "Select an existing driver container with driver_container_name; "
            "selection is ambiguous or missing"
        )
    for container in containers:
        if container["name"] != selected and not container.get("image"):
            raise ValueError(f"Sidecar {container['name']!r} requires an image")
    driver = next(container for container in containers if container["name"] == selected)
    generated_driver = managed["spec"]["containers"][0]
    driver.pop("command", None)  # Spark images must use their driver entrypoint.
    for field in ("image", "imagePullPolicy", "args"):
        driver[field] = generated_driver[field]
    resources = driver.setdefault("resources", {})
    for field in ("requests", "limits"):
        resources[field] = {**resources.get(field, {}), **generated_driver["resources"].get(field, {})}
    for field, key in (("env", "name"), ("volumeMounts", "mountPath")):
        driver[field] = _merge_items(driver.get(field, []), generated_driver.get(field, []), _field_key(key))
    driver["ports"] = _merge_items(
        driver.get("ports", []),
        generated_driver.get("ports", []),
        lambda port: port.get("name") or (port.get("containerPort"), port.get("protocol", "TCP")),
    )
    driver["envFrom"] = deepcopy(driver.get("envFrom", []))
    for source in generated_driver.get("envFrom", []):
        if source not in driver["envFrom"]:
            driver["envFrom"].append(source)
    spec = pod["spec"]
    spec["containers"] = [driver, *(container for container in containers if container["name"] != selected)]
    spec.pop("serviceAccount", None)
    for field in ("serviceAccountName", "restartPolicy"):
        spec[field] = managed["spec"][field]
    spec["nodeSelector"] = {**spec.get("nodeSelector", {}), **managed["spec"].get("nodeSelector", {})}
    for field, key in (("volumes", "name"), ("initContainers", "name"), ("hostAliases", "ip")):
        spec[field] = _merge_items(
            _items(spec.get(field, []), field), managed["spec"].get(field, []), _field_key(key)
        )
    spec["tolerations"] = _items(spec.get("tolerations", []), "tolerations")
    for toleration in managed["spec"].get("tolerations", []):
        if toleration not in spec["tolerations"]:
            spec["tolerations"].append(toleration)
    metadata = pod.setdefault("metadata", {})
    for field in ("name", "namespace"):
        metadata[field] = managed["metadata"][field]
    labels = metadata.setdefault("labels", {})
    for key in ("spark-app-name", "spark-app-id", "spark-role", "spark-ui-proxy"):
        labels.pop(key, None)
    labels.update(managed["metadata"]["labels"])
    metadata["annotations"] = {
        **metadata.get("annotations", {}),
        **managed["metadata"].get("annotations", {}),
        "kubectl.kubernetes.io/default-container": selected,
    }
    _validate_template(pod, allow_ownership=True)
    return pod

class WaitDeadline:
    """A monotonic timeout shared by polling, requests, and log streaming."""

    def __init__(self, timeout: float | None = None):
        if timeout is not None and (not math.isfinite(timeout) or timeout <= 0):
            raise ValueError("Wait timeout must be a positive finite number of seconds")
        self.end = None if timeout is None else time.monotonic() + timeout

    def remaining(self) -> float | None:
        if self.end is None:
            return None
        remaining = self.end - time.monotonic()
        if remaining <= 0:
            raise TimeoutError("Application wait timeout exceeded")
        return remaining

    def request_options(self) -> dict[str, float]:
        remaining = self.remaining()
        return {} if remaining is None else {"_request_timeout": remaining}

    def sleep(self, seconds: float) -> None:
        remaining = self.remaining()
        time.sleep(seconds if remaining is None else min(seconds, remaining))
        self.remaining()

class SparkOnK8SNamespaceSetup(LoggingMixin):
    """Utility class to set up a namespace for Spark on Kubernetes.

    Args:
        k8s_client_manager (KubernetesClientManager, optional): Kubernetes client manager.
            Defaults to None.
        logger_name (str, optional): logger name. Defaults to "SparkOnK8SNamespaceSetup".
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        *,
        k8s_client_manager: KubernetesClientManager | None = None,
        logger_name: str | None = None,
    ):
        super().__init__(logger_name=logger_name or "SparkOnK8SNamespaceSetup")
        self.k8s_client_manager = k8s_client_manager or KubernetesClientManager()

    def setup_namespace(self, namespace: str, should_print: bool = False):
        """Set up a namespace for Spark on Kubernetes.

        This method creates a namespace if it doesn't exist, creates a service account for Spark
        if it doesn't exist, and creates a cluster role binding for the service account and the
        edit cluster role if it doesn't exist.

        Args:
            namespace (str): the namespace to set up
            should_print (bool, optional): whether to print logs instead of logging them.
                Defaults to False.
        """
        with self.k8s_client_manager.client() as client:
            api = k8s.CoreV1Api(client)
            namespaces = [ns.metadata.name for ns in api.list_namespace().items]
            if namespace not in namespaces:
                self.log(msg=f"Creating namespace {namespace}", level=logging.INFO, should_print=should_print)
                api.create_namespace(
                    body=k8s.V1Namespace(
                        metadata=k8s.V1ObjectMeta(
                            name=namespace,
                        ),
                    ),
                )
            service_accounts = [
                sa.metadata.name for sa in api.list_namespaced_service_account(namespace=namespace).items
            ]
            if "spark" not in service_accounts:
                self.log(
                    msg=f"Creating spark service account in namespace {namespace}",
                    level=logging.INFO,
                    should_print=should_print,
                )
                api.create_namespaced_service_account(
                    namespace=namespace,
                    body=k8s.V1ServiceAccount(
                        metadata=k8s.V1ObjectMeta(
                            name="spark",
                        ),
                    ),
                )
            rbac_api = k8s.RbacAuthorizationV1Api(client)
            cluster_role_bindings = [crb.metadata.name for crb in rbac_api.list_cluster_role_binding().items]
            role_binding_name = f"spark-role-binding-{namespace}"
            if role_binding_name not in cluster_role_bindings:
                self.log(msg="Creating spark role binding", level=logging.INFO, should_print=should_print)
                rbac_api.create_cluster_role_binding(
                    body=k8s.V1ClusterRoleBinding(
                        metadata=k8s.V1ObjectMeta(
                            name=role_binding_name,
                        ),
                        role_ref=k8s.V1RoleRef(
                            api_group="rbac.authorization.k8s.io",
                            kind="ClusterRole",
                            name="edit",
                        ),
                        subjects=[

docs.title: setup_namespace(namespace, should_print=False)
docs.text:
Set up a namespace for Spark on Kubernetes.

This method creates a namespace if it doesn't exist, creates a service account for Spark if it doesn't exist, and creates a cluster role binding for the service account and the edit cluster role if it doesn't exist.

Parameters:

Name Type Description Default namespace str

the namespace to set up

required should_print bool

whether to print logs instead of logging them. Defaults to False.

False Source code in spark_on_k8s/utils/setup_namespace.py 
def setup_namespace(self, namespace: str, should_print: bool = False):
    """Set up a namespace for Spark on Kubernetes.

    This method creates a namespace if it doesn't exist, creates a service account for Spark
    if it doesn't exist, and creates a cluster role binding for the service account and the
    edit cluster role if it doesn't exist.

    Args:
        namespace (str): the namespace to set up
        should_print (bool, optional): whether to print logs instead of logging them.
            Defaults to False.
    """
    with self.k8s_client_manager.client() as client:
        api = k8s.CoreV1Api(client)
        namespaces = [ns.metadata.name for ns in api.list_namespace().items]
        if namespace not in namespaces:
            self.log(msg=f"Creating namespace {namespace}", level=logging.INFO, should_print=should_print)
            api.create_namespace(
                body=k8s.V1Namespace(
                    metadata=k8s.V1ObjectMeta(
                        name=namespace,
                    ),
                ),
            )
        service_accounts = [
            sa.metadata.name for sa in api.list_namespaced_service_account(namespace=namespace).items
        ]
        if "spark" not in service_accounts:
            self.log(
                msg=f"Creating spark service account in namespace {namespace}",
                level=logging.INFO,
                should_print=should_print,
            )
            api.create_namespaced_service_account(
                namespace=namespace,
                body=k8s.V1ServiceAccount(
                    metadata=k8s.V1ObjectMeta(
                        name="spark",
                    ),
                ),
            )
        rbac_api = k8s.RbacAuthorizationV1Api(client)
        cluster_role_bindings = [crb.metadata.name for crb in rbac_api.list_cluster_role_binding().items]
        role_binding_name = f"spark-role-binding-{namespace}"
        if role_binding_name not in cluster_role_bindings:
            self.log(msg="Creating spark role binding", level=logging.INFO, should_print=should_print)
            rbac_api.create_cluster_role_binding(
                body=k8s.V1ClusterRoleBinding(
                    metadata=k8s.V1ObjectMeta(
                        name=role_binding_name,
                    ),
                    role_ref=k8s.V1RoleRef(
                        api_group="rbac.authorization.k8s.io",
                        kind="ClusterRole",
                        name="edit",
                    ),
                    subjects=[
                        k8s.RbacV1Subject(
                            kind="ServiceAccount",
                            name="spark",
                            namespace=namespace,
                        )
                    ],
                ),
            )

Get app status.

Source code in spark_on_k8s/utils/spark_app_status.py 
def get_app_status(pod: k8s.V1Pod | k8s_async.V1Pod) -> SparkAppStatus:
    """Get app status."""
    if pod.status.phase == "Pending":
        return SparkAppStatus.Pending
    elif pod.status.phase == "Running":
        return SparkAppStatus.Running
    elif pod.status.phase == "Succeeded":
        return SparkAppStatus.Succeeded
    elif pod.status.phase == "Failed":
        return SparkAppStatus.Failed
    else:
        return SparkAppStatus.Unknown

docs.title: Airflow
docs.text: The source version supports Airflow 3.4 on Python 3.11–3.14 and Airflow 2.11.2 on Python 3.11–3.12. Follow the installation instructions for the airflow extra; published releases can differ from the current source. Install it in the Airflow components that load and execute your DAGs, including the triggerer when using deferrable tasks. The package registers its provider automatically.

docs.title: Connect to Kubernetes
docs.text:
Configure an Airflow connection of type Kubernetes, with ID kubernetes_default. To use another connection, set kubernetes_conn_id on the operator. Choose one authentication method. For Airflow running inside Kubernetes, this environment variable uses the Airflow pod's service account:

export AIRFLOW_CONN_KUBERNETES_DEFAULT='{"conn_type":"kubernetes","extra":{"in_cluster":true}}'

For an external cluster, use the connection's kube_config_path and, optionally, cluster_context fields instead. The kubeconfig must be available wherever the task or trigger executes. See the provider's Kubernetes connection reference.

The connection authenticates Airflow to Kubernetes. The operator's namespace and service_account choose where Spark runs and which service account its driver uses; they do not inherit the connection's namespace. Follow Getting Started to prepare these resources and permissions. The examples use namespace spark and service account spark.

docs.title: Separate execution and task-tab permissions
docs.text:
Component/action Credential and authorization boundary Worker submits, waits or performs configured cleanup The selected Airflow Kubernetes connection; grant the required pod/service and optional Secret/ConfigMap operations only in approved namespaces Triggerer observes a deferred application The same connection ID resolved in the triggerer's own environment; it needs observation access, not permission to submit another job Spark driver creates executors The submission's service_account in its application namespace, independently of the worker's identity Native tab reads details/logs Airflow task/task-log access, verified task ownership, and the Spark API's own permissions Native tab kills/deletes The corresponding Airflow write permission, verified ownership, SPARK_ON_K8S_AIRFLOW_ALLOW_WRITES=true, and the Spark API's permissions

Setting the tab's allow-writes flag to false only disables browser actions. It does not prevent a DAG from submitting through its Kubernetes connection or from performing configured cleanup. Install the same integration version in workers and triggerers, and restrict their resolved credentials to the intended scope. A connection that works on a worker may still be unavailable to the triggerer.

docs.title: Load the example DAGs
docs.text:
The Airflow examples include spark_dag.py for a packaged PySpark job and spark_sql_dag.py for inline SQL and SQL files. Build the pyspark-job image using the Python example, then make it available on the cluster. image_pull_policy="Never" assumes the image is already loaded on the nodes. For a registry image, change image and use IfNotPresent or Always.

Deploy the DAG Python files to your Airflow DAG directory or DAG bundle. Keep query.sql and iceberg_query.sql beside spark_sql_dag.py, or set the DAG's template_searchpath to a directory containing them. That directory must also be available to task workers. The SQL templates use ds and ts; supply a logical date when triggering a manual run, or adapt those templates to your input values. Both example DAGs have schedule=None, so they run when triggered.

The SQL DAG creates four independent tasks with distinct application names. The inline example uses CREATE TABLE ... USING PARQUET AS SELECT; the multiple-query example renders its date as a SQL date literal. SparkSqlOnK8SOperator renders SQL before splitting it into statements and sends a JSON statement list to the Spark runner. Install the extra in Airflow; the Spark image does not need sqlparse.

docs.title: Prepare the Iceberg example
docs.text:
Before running spark_iceberg_sql_application, replace spark.sql.catalog.prod.uri with a REST catalog endpoint reachable from Spark's pods. The sample localhost address refers to the driver pod itself. Configure any catalog credentials and warehouse access your deployment requires.

The example runtime package targets Spark 3.5 with Scala 2.12; use an image and Iceberg runtime that match each other. Create the prod.db namespace and the source table prod.db.another_sample with id, data, and category columns. The query creates the target prod.db.sample if needed, then merges from that source table. It does not provision a catalog, warehouse, or source dataset.

docs.title: Spark UI links and waiting
docs.text:
To enable the Spark Job UI operator link, set spark_on_k8s_service_url to the base URL of a deployed spark-on-k8s API that the browser can reach. Set ui_reverse_proxy=True for access to the running driver's UI. Enabling the reverse proxy alone, as in the examples, does not set an Airflow link URL.

The operator stores the live UI URL in XCom after submission or adoption. For tasks that wait for completion, it then replaces that URL with the history URL. The history destination requires Spark event logging, a Spark History Server, and the API's SPARK_ON_K8S_API_SPARK_HISTORY_HOST configuration. The link does not create that infrastructure. With app_waiter="no_wait", the operator returns after submission and leaves the live link in place.

With deferrable=True, waiting runs in the Airflow triggerer. If app_waiter="log" is also set, logs are read when the task resumes after completion.

docs.title: Lifecycle, retries and cleanup
docs.text:
The table applies to app_waiter="wait" or "log" unless stated otherwise. startup_timeout bounds the driver's Pending phase; 0 disables that deadline. It is separate from Airflow's task execution timeout.

Outcome or event Task outcome and application action Spark succeeds Task succeeds; keep retains the application, delete and keep_if_failed delete it Spark fails Task fails; keep and keep_if_failed retain it, delete deletes it Driver startup deadline expires Task fails and deletes the application, including with on_finish_action="keep"; applies to synchronous and deferred waiting Deferred trigger reports an observation error Task fails with the trigger error; keep retains the application, while delete and keep_if_failed delete it because an observation error is not a confirmed Spark Failed state Synchronous observation raises a non-timeout API/transport error Error propagates before finish cleanup; no new submission or automatic cleanup is performed by that wait path app_waiter="no_wait" Returns after submission/adoption; no finish cleanup or completion assertion Airflow invokes on_kill with a known driver on_kill_action="keep" retains, "delete" requests deletion, and "kill" requests process termination; default is delete

Do not assume every scheduler state change, worker loss or manual task-state edit invokes on_kill. A termination request also does not prove that application output was rolled back. The SDK/CLI retain applications after observation timeout or interruption; the Airflow startup-timeout deletion policy is intentionally different. See the automation contract.

When task-local XCom still contains the recorded namespace and driver name, a retry adopts a Pending or Running application. Confirmed absence (Kubernetes 404), or a confirmed Succeeded/Failed application, permits the existing new-job path. Authentication failures, unavailable status lookups and Unknown status now fail the task before submission. Restoring access lets a later attempt inspect the same recorded identity; uncertainty is not treated as absence.

This depends on retained XCom. Airflow may clear XCom during a retry, and a crash between pod creation and receipt persistence remains outside this guarantee. It is not submission deduplication or an exactly-once data-write promise. Applications must define their own handling of a repeated logical date.

For a daily DAG, choose the startup deadline and retention behavior explicitly. Replace the example image with your approved application artifact:

from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta
from airflow import DAG
from spark_on_k8s.airflow.operators import SparkOnK8SOperator

with DAG(
    "daily_transform", schedule="@daily", catchup=False,
    start_date=datetime(2026, 1, 1, tzinfo=UTC),
) as dag:
    SparkOnK8SOperator(
        task_id="transform",
        image="registry.example.com/team/daily-job:approved",
        app_path="local:///opt/spark/work-dir/job.py",
        namespace="analytics", service_account="spark-driver",
        app_arguments=["--run-date", "{{ ds }}"],
        driver_labels={"logical-date": "{{ ds_nodash }}"},
        executor_labels={"logical-date": "{{ ds_nodash }}"},
        deferrable=True, startup_timeout=180, poll_interval=10,
        on_finish_action="keep_if_failed", on_kill_action="delete",
        retries=2, retry_delay=timedelta(minutes=2),
    )

packages and driver/executor labels and annotations support Airflow templates, alongside the existing image, arguments and resource fields. Use valid Kubernetes label values after rendering. The reserved spark-on-k8s.io/airflow-task annotation is generated from task identity and cannot be overridden by a user annotation. Previously literal Jinja expressions in these newly templated fields will now be rendered; review existing DAGs when upgrading.

docs.title: Verify the integration on Kubernetes
docs.text:
The source workflow .github/workflows/airflow-kubernetes.yml builds the wheel and runs Airflow 2.11.2 and 3.4.0 in service-account-bearing pods against the representative Spark 4.0.5 image. It checks successful work, deliberate Spark failure after real executor work, and an unschedulable startup timeout, each in synchronous and deferred mode. Deferred cases run and resume the real trigger.

This uses Airflow's DAG.test() engine, metadata database and XCom. It does not qualify a separately deployed scheduler, executor or triggerer process, or worker-crash recovery. The broader Spark runtime matrix remains in the Spark compatibility workflow. Follow the Airflow workflow's image-building and kind setup, then run its exact host command from the repository root:

.venv/bin/python -I tests/integration/airflow/run_kubernetes.py \
  --kubeconfig "$RUNNER_TEMP/airflow-kubeconfig" \
  --airflow-image "airflow-compat:$AIRFLOW_VERSION" \
  --airflow-version "$AIRFLOW_VERSION" \
  --spark-image "airflow-spark:$SPARK_VERSION" --spark-version "$SPARK_VERSION" \
  --artifacts "$RUNNER_TEMP/airflow-kubernetes-results"

The default context is kind-airflow-compat; the runner refuses non-kind contexts. Inspect all six cases in result.json, the Airflow log, cluster pods/events/logs and kind logs. A passing unit suite or an unexecuted workflow is not real-cluster evidence. See the development guide for installed-wheel checks and the complete validation policy.

docs.title: Native task tab in Airflow 3
docs.text:
The optional Spark on Kubernetes tab is available for SparkOnK8SOperator and SparkSqlOnK8SOperator task instances on Airflow 3.4 or newer, below Airflow 4. It reuses the standalone console's React components for application details, logs, actions and history links. Airflow 2.11.2 continues to support the operators and Spark Job UI link, but does not load this tab.

This feature describes the current source, not an earlier PyPI release. Install from the checkout as described in Installation:

uv sync --python 3.12 --locked --no-default-groups --extra airflow-ui
# Or, in an activated virtual environment:
python -m pip install ".[airflow-ui]"

The airflow-ui extra includes the Airflow operator dependencies and the plugin's HTTP and WebSocket dependencies; it does not require the standalone api extra in the Airflow process. Install the same package version in the Airflow API server and task workers. Deploy the spark-on-k8s API from that version separately with its api extra, so its console endpoints can return the driver's task ownership metadata. Built JavaScript and CSS are included in the Python package.

Set these variables before starting the Airflow API server, then restart it:

export SPARK_ON_K8S_AIRFLOW_SERVICE_URL='http://spark-on-k8s.spark.svc.cluster.local:8000'
export SPARK_ON_K8S_AIRFLOW_PUBLIC_URL='https://spark.example.com'
export SPARK_ON_K8S_AIRFLOW_ALLOW_WRITES='false'
